jobs.title: Senior Application Engineer (100%)
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Application Engineer (100%)

Zurich |  up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 8017

You are enthusiastic about exciting projects in the financial industry, you enjoy working with internal and external interfaces and you are good at managing IT systems? Then become part of our IT team.

What You Will Do

• develop, maintain, and support IT applications in the Connectivity Area for Post Trading using Java, Spring Boot, Spring Integration, and related frameworks. Collaborate closely with business and technical stakeholders to understand requirements, translate them into effective solutions, and communicate clearly across different stakeholder groups

• ensure smooth IT operations (3rd Level application support) and incident management within SLA requirements, including ITSM processes, service desk activities, problem resolution, and participation in a rotating on-call (picket) support schedule (approx. once every 4–6 weeks) using Jira and Confluence.

• implement and deploy new releases across Development, Test, and Production environments (OCP, Linux), leveraging CI/CD pipelines and tools such as GitLab, Maven, JFrog.

• adhere to architectural, security, and compliance standards throughout the development lifecycle, utilizing best practices and tools like SonarQube and XRAY.

• drives continuous improvement in application SLAs, monitoring, and automation by leveraging, Grafana, Elastic, Ansible and proactively managing technical debt.

• interacts with other stakeholders: Application Architects, Solution Designers, Project Teams and Developers

What You Bring

• 9-14 years of hands-on experience in software development, application maintenance, and production support, with a strong commitment to resolving critical issues.

• solid experience in Java technologies (Spring Boot, JPA/Hibernate) and with relational databases such as Oracle and MS SQL.

• proficiency with modern DevOps and automation tools, including Git, Maven, Helm 3, Ansible, and Argo CD.

• experience in C/C++ is a plus

• ability to thrive in fast-paced, agile environments, demonstrating flexibility to work outside normal hours when needed to support production.

• excellent English communication skills (written and spoken) are required; domain knowledge of banking or post-trading services is a plus.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska  at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX ci spinge alla trasformazione dei mercati finanziari. Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Valorizziamo le menti brillanti e li ispiriamo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi. Senior Application Engineer (100%) Zurigo | fino al 40% lavorando da casa possibile | Reference 8017 Sei entusiasta di progetti entusiasmanti nel settore finanziario, ti piace lavorare con interfacce interne ed esterne e sei bravo a gestire i sistemi IT? Poi entrare a far parte del nostro team IT. Cosa farete
• sviluppare, mantenere e sostenere applicazioni IT nell'area Connettività per Post Trading utilizzando Java, Spring Boot, Spring Integration e relativi framework. Il gruppo ha inoltre adottato una serie di misure per migliorare la qualità dei servizi di assistenza e assistenza alle imprese, in particolare per quanto riguarda la gestione degli incidenti e la gestione degli incidenti, in particolare mediante l'uso di Jira e Confluence.
• implementare e implementare nuove release in ambienti di sviluppo, test e produzione (OCP, Linux), sfruttando condotte e strumenti CI/CD come GitLab, Maven, JFrog.
• aderire agli standard architettonici, di sicurezza e di conformità durante tutto il ciclo di vita dello sviluppo, utilizzando best practice e strumenti come SonarQube e XRAY.
• guidare il miglioramento continuo nelle applicazioni SLA, monitoraggio e automazione sfruttando, Grafana, elastico, Ansibile e la gestione proattiva del debito tecnico.
• interagisce con altri stakeholder: Application Architects, Solution Designer, Project Teams e Developers What You Bring
• 9-14 anni di esperienza pratica nello sviluppo software, nella manutenzione delle applicazioni e nel supporto alla produzione, con un forte impegno a risolvere problemi critici.
• solida esperienza nelle tecnologie Java (Spring Boot, JPA/Hibernate) e con database relazionali come l'Oscuro e MS SQL.
• competenza con moderni strumenti di automazione e DevOps, tra cui Git, Maven, Helm 3, Ansible e Argo CD.
• esperienza in C/C++ è un plus
• capacità di prosperare in ambienti agrari veloci, agali, dimostrando flessibilità per lavorare al di fuori delle ore normali quando necessario per sostenere la produzione.
• eccellenti capacità di comunicazione inglese (scritto e parlato) sono necessari; dominio conoscenza di servizi bancari o post-trading è un plus. Se avete domande, controllare la nostra pagina FAQ o chiamare Beata Czyzewska a +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49. Per questo posto vacante accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette. La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere domande indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
SIX est un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondation et de croissance. Nous valorisons les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous. Ingénieur d'application senior (100%) Zurich, jusqu'à 40% de travail à domicile possible, Référence 8017 Vous êtes enthousiastes par des projets passionnants dans le secteur financier, vous aimez travailler avec des interfaces internes et externes et vous êtes bon dans la gestion des systèmes informatiques? Ce que vous ferez
• développer, maintenir et soutenir des applications informatiques dans la zone de connectivité pour le post-trading en utilisant Java, Spring Boot, Spring Integration et des cadres connexes. Collaborer étroitement avec les intervenants commerciaux et techniques pour comprendre les exigences, les traduire en solutions efficaces et communiquer clairement entre les différents groupes d'intervenants
• assurer des opérations informatiques sans heurts (assistance de niveau 3) et la gestion des incidents dans le cadre des exigences de l'ALS, y compris les processus de la GSTI, les activités du bureau de service, la résolution des problèmes et la participation à un horaire de soutien en rotation (en attente) (approx. une fois toutes les 4-6 semaines) en utilisant Jira et Confluence.
• mettre en œuvre et déployer de nouvelles versions dans les environnements de développement, de test et de production (OCP, Linux), en tirant parti des pipelines et des outils CI/CD tels que GitLab, Maven, JFrog.
• respecter les normes architecturales, de sécurité et de conformité tout au long du cycle de vie du développement, en utilisant les meilleures pratiques et outils comme SonarQube et XRAY.
• favoriser l'amélioration continue des applications SLA, de suivi et d'automatisation en tirant parti, Grafana, Elastic, Ansible et en gérant proactivement la dette technique.
• Interagir avec d'autres parties prenantes : Architectes d'applications, concepteurs de solutions, équipes de projet et développeurs Ce que vous apportez
• 9-14 ans d'expérience pratique dans le développement de logiciels, la maintenance d'applications et le soutien de la production, avec un engagement fort pour résoudre les problèmes critiques.
• une solide expérience dans les technologies Java (Spring Boot, JPA/Hibernate) et avec des bases de données relationnelles telles qu'Oracle et MS SQL.
• la maîtrise des outils DevOps modernes et d'automatisation, y compris Git, Maven, Helm 3, Ansible et Argo CD.
• l'expérience en C/C++ est une plus
• la capacité de prospérer dans des environnements agiles rapides, démontrant une flexibilité pour travailler en dehors des heures normales lorsque nécessaire pour soutenir la production.
• d'excellentes compétences en communication anglaise (écrites et parlées) sont nécessaires; la connaissance du domaine des services bancaires ou post-trading est un plus. Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Beata Czyzewska au +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49. Pour cette vacance, nous acceptons uniquement les applications directes. La diversité est importante pour nous. Nous cherchons donc à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel. <di

jobs.title: Equity Commercial Department Internship
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Equity Commercial Department Internship

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8021

Are you interested in learning about Capital Markets and financial sector? On this internship, you will have the opportunity to be part of our BME Equity Primary Market Department. This is a dynamic team in charge of the contact with our main clients: issuers and investors. On this team you will be able to participate and provide commercial support for meetings with investors and other forums that are organized to serve listed issuers and collaborate in the daily basis of the department.

What You Will Do

• collaborate in the organization of BME Corporate Access Events, MedCap Forum – Latibex Forum - All caps Conference

• analysis, selection and invitation of European institutional investors for these events. For this, the Nasdaq IR Insight system that we have contracted at BME is used

• help in the organization of different roadshows with European listed companies

• collaborate in the tasks of identifying potential listed companies for the elaboration of the commercial plan for attracting companies

• updating pertinent data in the CRM, configuration of reports and sending of communications

• work in coordination of all the necessary tasks for the department between the different teams: Web team, Communication, BME Growth, etc

What You Bring

• studies in business administration, finance, capital markets, marketing, public relations or something related

• good knowledge of MS Office applications (Excel, PPT)

• high customer orientation and dedication to service

• constructive and responsible attitude with analysis capacity oriented to work with diverse teams and under pressure for deadlines

• fluency in English verbal & written (B2 level minimum)

• knowledge about the functioning of the market in all its phases will be valued: trading, settlement, dissemination of information, etc

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: QA Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

QA Automation Engineer

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7922

Do you want to work in an agile, self-organized environment where collaboration, trust, and innovation are paramount? Are you passionate about testing and test automation? Are you eager to upskill making us of AI. Then, apply now and become part of the Securities Finance IT department.

We are looking for a QA Test Automation Engineer who shares this enthusiasm. You will play a crucial role to uplift the speed and quality of our deliveries by solving technical challenges and implementing new tests with cutting edge technologies and frameworks. You act across teams with a focus on end-to-end responsibility.

What You Will Do

• Contribute on integrating AI in the Test Case Life Cycle and QA process

• Develop test strategies designed to improve software quality and test coverage

• Guild, improve, migrate and maintain our test suites and pipelines

• Investigate, triage, and troubleshoot software defects

• Identify opportunities to automate testing and data management using a variety of tools and techniques

What You Bring

• Proven experience as a QA Automation Engineer and demonstrated ability to design and implement effective test strategies and test cases.

• Experience using programming languages (Java, JavaScript), experience in Linux and the use of DevOps tools and pipelines with GitLab/GitHub, Docker, OpenShift / Kubernetes.

• Deep understanding and practical experience with test tools / frameworks (Playwright, Cypress, Junit, etc.)

• Hands-on experience with AI tools in coding is a plus (ClaudeCode, Copilot)

• Good communication skills, the ability to collaborate effectively within a team as well as fluent in English and Spanish.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Senior Tax Expert
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Tax Expert

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7955

Are you interested in working in a highly dynamic environment with international tax exposure? We are looking for an experienced Senior Tax Specialist to join our Group Tax / Tax Management team in Spain. This role requires a self-driven professional who independently manages key tax matters, including tax compliance, tax planning, and advisory support to the group on topics such as restructurings and acquisitions. A particular focus lies on FATCA and QI compliance, where deep expertise and practical experience are essential. Beyond this, you will cover a wide spectrum of responsibilities within an international tax function.

What You Will Do

• Own and manage FATCA and QI compliance processes, including reporting, controls, and coordination with key stakeholders such as the tax operations teams in Switzerland

• Oversee EU DAC obligations, ensuring accurate data validation, documentation, and regulatory submissions

• Act as a tax business partner to BSS Business Units, providing advisory support on products, services, and operational tax matters

• Collaborate closely with Swiss and Spanish teams to align processes and ensure consistent tax governance standards

• Support transfer pricing topics, including data preparation, documentation, and coordination with internal experts

• Take responsibility for corporate tax compliance and tax reporting across relevant entities

• Contribute to tax planning initiatives and provide support on group-wide projects, including restructurings and M&A activities

• Provide comprehensive tax advice on a broad range of international and local tax matters within the group

What You Bring

• Degree in Tax, Business, or Economics with hands-on experience in FATCA, QI, and tax compliance frameworks

• Solid experience in international or regulated environments with exposure to EU or US tax reporting obligations

• Ability to work independently with structured and reliable approach in compliance-driven environments

• Strong communication skills to collaborate across teams and explain complex tax matters to internal and external stakeholders clearly

• Needed Language Skills: English and Spanish

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Working Student Web Publishing & UX Support

Zurich |  50% | Reference 8014

Are you passionate about websites and eager to enhance digital user experiences? Would you like to work in an international environment? Join our Digital Communications team as a Working Student – Web Publishing & UX Support.

In this role, you will manage and publish content on six-group.com, collaborate with stakeholders, and contribute to continuous UX improvements. Your ideas will help us strengthen the brand of SIX and deliver an outstanding online experience.

As a modern, dynamic, and innovative company at the intersection of technology and finance, SIX offers a wide range of opportunities to grow and make a real impact. We are committed to supporting your development, helping you expand both your professional knowledge and personal skills. We look forward to receiving your application in English.

What You Will Do

• Assist in web optimization and continuous improvement projects

• Publish and update corporate content on six-group.com using Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), following established guidelines and best practices.

• Support business stakeholders in updating and managing website content

• Integrate SEO/GEO and UX best practices to improve website performance and user experience

• Collaborate with the UX specialist by contributing ideas and recommendations

What You Bring

• Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in digital marketing or web development; looking for a part-time working student role

• Experience with CMS tools (e.g., Adobe AEM) and Figma for wireframing/prototyping is a plus

• Understanding of UX/UI, SEO/GEO, or web copywriting is an advantage

• Strong attention to detail, ensuring content accuracy, consistency, and guideline compliance

• Organized, ownership-driven mindset with fluent communication skills in English and German

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Janine Reichling  at +41 58 399 42 99 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de bord du client (technologie de réglementation financière)

jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Client Onboarding Manager (Financial regulatory technology)

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7965

Do you enjoy leading complex client onboardings where trust, clarity and execution matter? Join our RegTech team and help financial institutions successfully adopt SaaS solutions for Transaction Cost Analysis, Best Execution and Trade Surveillance. This is a senior customer-facing role with a strategic focus on DACH clients. You will work with compliance, operations, IT and business stakeholders, coordinating internally with Product, Engineering, Support and Sales. As our platforms evolve faster through AI-augmented delivery, human trust, expectation management and delivery credibility become even more important.

What You Will Do

• Lead complex customer onboardings from planning to successful production adoption.

• Serve as a reliable escalation point for client questions and issues, ensuring timely resolution, clear communication and proper assessment of root causes and impact.

• Coordinate across Product, Engineering, Support and Sales to ensure clear commitments and reliable delivery.

• Understand client workflows, data requirements, operational constraints and regulatory expectations.

• Support demos, RFPs, client workshops and service reviews with credible product and operational knowledge.

• Identify recurring customer pain points and help turn them into product, process or tooling improvements.

What You Bring

• Strong client-facing experience with financial institutions, ideally in SaaS, RegTech, market data or financial technology.

• Professional-level German and fluent English; Spanish or French are an advantage.

• Ability to build trust with compliance officers, IT teams, operations specialists and senior stakeholders.

• Structured project and onboarding management skills.

• Calm authority, ownership mindset and excellent communication in complex situations.

• Interest in financial markets, regulation, technology and long-term customer success

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Senior Client Onboarding & Platform operations (Financial regulatory technology)

titleByLocale.it: Senior Client Onboarding & Platform operations (tecnologia di regolamentazione finanziaria)
titleByLocale.en: Senior Client Onboarding & Platform operations (Financial regulatory technology)
titleByLocale.fr: Client principal Opérations d'embarquement et de plateforme (Technologie de réglementation financière)

jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Client Onboarding & Platform operations (Financial regulatory technology)

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7966

Do you like turning incidents, client pain and operational complexity into better products and stronger platforms? Join our RegTech team in a hybrid role between Product, Engineering, Operations, Support and Clients.

Our RegTech SaaS solutions support financial institutions with Transaction Cost Analysis, Best Execution and Trade Surveillance. As AI-augmented delivery increases change velocity, we need strong operational product ownership to ensure resilience, monitoring, security, onboarding efficiency and client delivery improve systematically - not ad hoc.

What You Will Do

• Own and prioritize the backlog for platform operations, monitoring, resilience, onboarding tooling and technical client delivery.

• Translate incidents, support cases, client requests and due-diligence questions into structural improvements.

• Work with Engineering and Platform teams to improve observability, maintainability, automation an operational robustness.

• Support RFPs, DORA/security questionnaires and technical discussions with clients.

• Define requirements for internal tools that reduce manual effort and key-person dependency.

• Bridge Product, Support, Engineering, Sales and Clients with clear priorities and practical execution.

• Level 2 support for complex technical issues and help translate recurring incidents, onboarding frictions and reliability concerns into better monitoring, testing, documentation and platform improvements.

What You Bring

• Strong technical reasoning across Linux, logs, SQL, APIs, data flows and production systems.

• Experience owning backlogs, writing clear requirements and prioritizing across competing needs.

• Client-facing credibility on technical, operational or regulatory topics.

• Ability to spot patterns in operational work and convert them into scalable solutions.

• Structured communication, pragmatic judgment and a bias for repeatability and simplification.

• Very good English; Spanish, German or French are an advantage.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer
jobs.description:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Full-Stack Developer

Warsaw |  working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 7935

As part of the IT organization serving the Financial Information business unit, we are continuously improving our customers' and internal users' experience.

Our team is developing and operating the applications which manage the licensing of our data sets towards both our clients and suppliers. We are using state-of-the-art technologies for every stage of our systems.

Are you passionate about modern technology and solving problems? Do you want to work in an agile, self-organized environment where collaboration, trust, innovation and continuous improvement are paramount? Then, our motivated software development team wants to hear from you.

What You Will Do

• develop and maintain software across the full development lifecycle

• collaborate with product owners and team members to deliver solutions

• ship high-quality, well-reviewed code within deadlines

• support production systems & have on-call responsibilities

• participate in Scrum ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement

What You Bring

• 3+ years of experience with Java, Spring, Rest APIs, SQL.

• backend knowledge is a must with an educated opinion on best practices and design topics.

• experience with container platforms (e.g. Openshift), DevOps tools for CI/CD (e.g. Gitlab) and observability (e.g. Grafana).

• frontend knowledge in React would be an advantage

• strong sense of quality through integration tests and unit tests.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa  at .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: IT DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

IT DevOps Engineer

Madrid, Barcelona |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7856

Do you want to work in an agile environment where passion, trust, innovation, and operational robustness are key principles?
Are you motivated to learn, grow your technical skills, and contribute to modern DevOps practices while working alongside experienced engineers?
If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you!
We are looking for an Application Ops Engineer to join our Operations Team and support application development teams through automation, standardized CI/CD pipelines, and the configuration of shared operational platforms.
In this role, you will contribute to building and operating scalable deployment and automation solutions, while gaining hands-on experience with tools such as GitLab, Ansible, ArgoCD, Airflow, and Python, and collaborating closely with developers and platform teams to ensure operational quality and Operations best practices across the application lifecycle.

What You Will Do

• Contribute to the design, implementation, and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines using GitLab and ArgoCD

• Develop, adapt, and maintain reusable automation templates using Ansible

• Support development teams in integrating deployment pipelines, workflows, and observability configurations

• Assist in the operation and improvement of scheduling and workflow automation platforms such as Airflow

• Write and maintain Python scripts to support automation, integrations, and operational tasks

• Help drive standardization, security, and scalability in build and deployment workflows

• Collaborate with central infrastructure teams on provisioning, upgrades, and shared platform services (e.g. Grafana, Vault, ELK)

• Document processes, configurations, and best practices, contributing to continuous improvement initiatives

• Learn and apply modern DevOps tooling and practices, sharing knowledge within the team

What You Bring

• A strong interest in DevOps and automation across the software delivery lifecycle

• Hands-on experience or practical knowledge of GitLab CI/CD, Ansible, ArgoCD, or similar tools

• Basic experience with Python for scripting or automation purposes

• Familiarity with Linux environments and application deployments

• Exposure to observability or monitoring tools such as Grafana, ELK, Prometheus is a plus

• Willingness to learn, ask questions, and collaborate in a cross-functional environment

• Proactive mindset, good communication skills, and a team-oriented attitude

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: QA Engineer
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

QA Engineer

Madrid |  working from home up to 40% | Reference 7968

Do you enjoy being the person who asks "are we sure?" before software reaches production? Join our RegTech team and help us build confidence in mission-critical SaaS solutions used by financial institutions for Transaction Cost Analysis, Best Execution and Trade Surveillance.

As AI-assisted development increases delivery speed, quality engineering becomes more strategic than ever. This is not a manual testing role. It is a technical engineering role focused on automated verification, regression prevention, release confidence and system correctness in a complex, data-heavy platform.

What You Will Do

• Define and evolve the QA and verification strategy for our RegTech SaaS platforms.

• Build automated test suites, regression checks, CI quality gates and release validation processes.

• Design test scenarios for distributed, data-intensive systems, including edge cases and failure modes.

• Work with developers to improve testability, observability and confidence in AI-assisted code changes.

• Support performance, integration, data-quality and end-to-end validation across environments.

• Help create a culture where quality is owned by everyone, but supported by strong tooling and expert guidance.

What You Bring

• Strong technical background in software engineering, QA automation or reliability engineering.

• Experience with automated testing frameworks, CI/CD pipelines and regression tooling.

• Analytical mindset, attention to detail and curiosity for complex system behavior.

• Ability to understand data flows, logs, APIs, databases and production-like environments.

• Confidence to challenge assumptions constructively and help teams make better release decisions.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Platform Engineer

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7967

Are you excited by the opportunity to shape the platform behind mission-critical RegTech SaaS solutions used by financial institutions? Join our RegTech team and help us scale the reliability, resilience and delivery capacity of our Transaction Cost Analysis, Best Execution and Trade Surveillance platforms.

We are evolving towards an AI-augmented engineering model, where software delivery becomes faster and platform governance, automation, observability and security become even more important. In this role, you will work peer-to-peer with senior engineers to make sure our platform can safely support that next level of change.

What You Will Do

• Co-own the RegTech platform across Kubernetes/OpenShift, CI/CD, Linux systems, databases, observability and release processes.

• Design and improve scalable, secure and repeatable infrastructure for production and non-production environments.

• Strengthen deployment automation, monitoring, alerting, runbooks and incident response capabilities.

• Drive platform improvements around resilience, performance, security, vulnerability management and compliance readiness.

• Collaborate with software engineering, support and product teams to turn operational risks into structural improvements.

• Promote documentation, automation and knowledge sharing to reduce key-person dependency.

What You Bring

• Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes/OpenShift, Linux, CI/CD, containers and automation.

• Solid understanding of distributed systems, databases, networking, security and production failure modes.

• Experience operating business-critical platforms in regulated, financial or high-assurance environments.

• Good judgment: you know when to move fast, when to simplify and when to challenge a risky change.

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to explain complex technical topics clearly.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: QA & Testing Governance Lead

titleByLocale.fr: AQ et test de gouvernance Responsable

jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

QA & Testing Governance Lead

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7940

If you have strong experience in QA and Test Management, combined with a structured mindset and the ability to align diverse teams around common standards, we would welcome you to join us as QA & Testing Governance Lead within Securities Services IT at SIX.
This role is part of the Program & Service Management function and is responsible for defining and driving common QA and testing governance, standards, and best practices across Securities Services IT. While Test Managers and testing roles are embedded in the different vertical areas, this position ensures a shared “common ground” and consistent quality governance across the organization.
Depending on needs and priorities, the role may also include acting as Test Manager in selected projects within the vertical areas, combining strategic governance responsibilities with hands on delivery involvement.

Does it sound interesting to you? We are looking forward to meeting you. Apply now with your CV in English!

What You Will Do

• Define, maintain and evolve QA and Testing governance, standards and best practices for Securities Services IT, with a strong focus on enabling shift‑left quality practices in close collaboration with engineering teams.

• Establish and maintain a common reference model for test phases, entry/exit criteria, go live quality gates and production readiness expectations.

• Act as the central coordination point for Test Management practices, fostering alignment and reuse of proven approaches across the different vertical areas.

• Define and standardize quality metrics, KPIs and reporting, enabling transparency, comparability and data driven decision making.

• Drive alignment of testing and test automation practices and tooling, favoring enablement models (e.g. shared baselines, self‑service approaches) over purely top‑down enforcement, while balancing standardization with context‑specific needs.

• Contribute, when required, as Test Manager in concrete initiatives or projects, supporting test planning, defect governance and go live readiness.

What You Bring

• 7+ years of hands‑on experience in QA, Test Management or Quality Governance in complex IT environments (regulated or mission‑critical contexts are a strong advantage).

• Proven experience defining and rolling out standards, governance models, processes and metrics across multiple teams or units.

• Strong understanding of test phases, testing strategies, entry/exit criteria, defect management and production readiness.

• Solid knowledge of test management and defect tracking tools and evidence‑based quality reporting, including metrics that help connect quality outcomes with delivery performance.

• Location in Spain, with willingness to travel occasionally to Switzerland.

• Fluent English (mandatory); Spanish highly valued; German a plus.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns unterscheidet, treibt uns voran: Zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, aus Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Komm und gestalte die Zukunft der Finanzmärkte mit uns.

Specialist Settlement (80%)

Olten |  bis zu 40% Home Office möglich | Referenz 7912

Hast du Freude daran, komplexe Finanzprozesse aktiv mitzugestalten und sicherzustellen, dass auch Ausnahme-Situationen effizient gelöst werden? Das Team Settlement Special Services gewährleistet zentrale Dienstleistungen rund um die Wertschriftenabwicklung bei SIX SIS. Im Bereich Exception Handling übernehmen wir die Überwachung und Verarbeitung aller non-STP-Swift-Meldungen sowie verschiedener Kontrollreports. Mit einer proaktiven Steuerung unserer Prozesse und Risiken stellen wir einen zuverlässigen Betrieb und einen hohen Servicelevel sicher.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir eine(n) SpezialistIn Settlement, die/der Lust auf abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben, Verantwortung und ein dynamisches Umfeld mitbringt. Wir bieten dir eine spannende, vielseitige Position mit bis zu 40% Homeoffice. Mindestens drei Arbeitstage pro Woche verbringst du im Büro – wahlweise in Zürich oder Olten. Ein gemeinsamer Teamtag pro Woche findet fix in Olten statt.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• Koordination und Kommunikation mit internen und externen Schnittstellen, darunter Network Management, Depotstellen in verschiedenen Ländern, ICSDs, CSDs, Client Relationship Manager, Corporate Actions, Valorenstammdaten und Reconciliation

• Zeitgerechte Verarbeitung von non-STP Swift-Nachrichten (MT54x) von über 50 Ländern

• Investigation und Korrekturverbuchung von Reconciliationbreaks

• Kontinuierliche Optimierung der Abwicklungsabläufe sowie Pflege und Weiterentwicklung

Das bringst du mit

• Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Grundausbildung; idealerweise mit Banklehre oder vergleichbarer Qualifikation

• Fundiertes Fachwissen im Wertschriftenbereich, sowie praktische Erfahrung im Tagesgeschäft; mehrjährige Erfahrung im Settlement ist wünschenswert

• Teamorientierte, engagierte Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägter Eigeninitiative und klarer, adressatengerechter Kommunikationsfähigkeit

• Analytische und strukturierte Arbeitsweise, schnelle Auffassungsgabe sowie hohe Zuverlässigkeit und ein starkes Verantwortungsbewusstsein

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Bei Fragen besuche unsere FAQ-Seite oder kontaktiere Beata Czyzewska  unter der Nummer +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49.

Für diese Vakanz berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.

Diversität ist uns wichtig, daher freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle

jobs.title: DevOps Software Engineer (Gitlab)
jobs.description:
SIX impulsa la transformación de los mercados financieros.

Lo que nos hace diferente, nos impulsa a avanzar: entre raíces locales y relevancia global, somos una mezcla única de tradición y futuro, de cimientos y crecimiento. Apreciamos el valor de mentes brillantes y las inspiramos a crecer con sus ideas. Da forma al futuro de las finanzas con nosotros.

DevOps Software Engineer (Gitlab)

Warsaw, Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Referencia  7860

Our centralized Software Development LifeCycle platform, based on GitLab and JFrog Artifactory, provides core capabilities to software developers across SIX.  We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to maintain and evolve our GitLab platform and enhance our GitLab components with related tooling, that empower product teams across the organization to increase efficacy and code quality.

What You Will Do

• take a leading role in maintaining and evolving our corporate SIX GitLab platform running in Azure

• design, implement, and manage GitLab components and configurations (groups, projects, runners, pipelines, templates, shared libraries)

• build and maintain shared CI/CD pipelines, reusable templates, automations and best-practice patterns for delivery at scale

• implement and maintain GitLab Runners (Kubernetes, autoscaling, Docker, Shell) with enterprise-grade reliability and security

• drive continuous improvement through automation, AI solutions, self-service capabilities and feedback loops

• create documentation, runbooks, and internal enablement materials; deliver training and provide Tier 2/3 support for GitLab and related tools

What You Bring

• 3+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or SRE, with focus on GitLab administration and CI/CD. Experience with GitLab Premium or Ultimate features is a plus

• proficiency with CI/CD concepts: branching strategies, pipeline as code, artifacts, environments, approvals, and compliance controls

• hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes),  deploying/scaling GitLab Runners on K8s, Prometheus and Grafana

• familiarity with IaC tools (Terraform, Helm) and configuration management (Ansible or similar). Strong scripting and automation skills (Bash, Python or similar)

• strong problem-solving skills, ownership mindset, and ability to work cross-functionally

• team-player with good verbal and written skills in English

Si tienes alguna duda, consulta nuestra página de preguntas frecuentes (FAQ) o contacta con Yuliya Stoyko   +34 917095993 .

Para esta vacante sólo aceptamos solicitudes directas.

La diversidad es importante para nosotros. Por lo tanto, estamos deseando recibir solicitudes independientemente de cualquier contexto personal.

jobs.title: Senior Data Architect
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Data Architect

Warsaw |  working from home up to 40% | Reference 7637

The Financial Information division within SIX Group is a global provider of financial data and analytics to the global financial services industry.  This role sits within the Business-led Product Development division and focuses on business data architecture, ensuring our financial data products meet customer, commercial and regulatory needs. The role partners closely with IT Architecture as a key stakeholder but is not part of the IT function.

We are looking for an experienced data architect to work within the Financial Information Product Delivery group to provide data architecture leadership across the firm to ensure our data products deliver value to our customers and they can be readily maintained and enhanced.  This encompasses the design and architecture of logical and physical data models and schemas, data transport mechanisms, metadata management, lineage management, API schema design and enabling SIX financial information to be accessible to AI agents.

What You Will Do

•    Design, develop and maintain the technology-agnostic, business-aligned canonical/conceptual data models for Financial Information, defining class definitions, standards and association semantics.
•    Provide data architecture expertise to all delivery teams to ensure we build data products that meet customer expectations, can be readily maintained and enhanced, and we have a core foundation on which we can readily build new revenue generating products.
•    Develop and maintain design, naming conventions, dictionaries, lineage and metadata standards, collaborating with data quality teams to ensure models support validation rules.
•    Partner with stakeholders across the business to translate complex data concepts and requirements into robust data products that customers want to purchase whilst contributing to the architectural governance process.
•    Support the evolution of data distribution models, including API-first delivery and AI data access enablement.

What You Bring

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Business Analyst

Warsaw |  Up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 8007

Are you passionate about market data compliance and eager to be part of the financial markets ecosystem? Do you excel in communication, influencing stakeholders, and driving meaningful change? We are looking for a dedicated team player to join our team at SIX Financial Information. In this role, you will contribute to the evolution of our entitlement platforms by gathering and documenting requirements, designing solutions, and collaborating across the organization to deliver measurable outcomes.

You will work closely with user groups and the Customer Experience team, and collaborate with Product Development, Compliance, Customer Support and Operations, Project Management and Architecture. You may also engage with external partners to integrate their solutions into our platforms.

This is a full-time position based in Warsaw, with up to 40% remote work as part of our hybrid working model.

Join SIX and contribute to the continuous improvement of our entitlement capabilities.

What You Will Do

• Elicit, analyze, and document business and functional requirements, translating them into clear specifications, and support delivery through backlog refinement and business acceptance testing.

• Maintain and enhance platform data configurations and data lineage relevant to entitlement and authorization processes.

• Analyze and improve cross-team processes related to platform operations and customer onboarding, with a focus on standardization, automation, and efficiency.

• Provide functional support to internal and external users on entitlement topics and contribute to systematic data quality and consistency checks across connected platforms.

What You Bring

• Bachelor’s degree or higher in Finance, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English (C1 or higher), including the ability to present complex topics clearly.

• 3 or more years of experience in financial services as a Business or Data Analyst, ideally in a market data or compliance-related environment.

• Hard skills

• Solid understanding of compliance requirements related to data usage.

• Strong requirements engineering and documentation skills

• Solid data analysis capabilities (advanced Excel; SQL is a plus)

• Experience in business process analysis and modeling

• Soft skills

• Proactive and structured mindset, with a strong willingness to learn

• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

• Effective collaboration and coordination skills across teams.

• Reliable team player with a pragmatic, solution-oriented approach.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa at +48 538 562 645

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Senior Observability Engineer
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Observability Engineer

Zurich |  up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 7664

The Senior Observability Engineer is a hands-on role focused on building and delivering observability and AIOps as a shared engineering capability and service. You will help establish how observability is designed, implemented, and consumed across teams, leading early onboardings and shaping practical standards, processes, and ways of working.

Working closely with platform, product, and application teams, you will translate requirements into actionable observability solutions, implement and operate core capabilities, and continuously improve how insights, alerting, and automation support reliable services. As a core contributor to the Observability & AIOps Center of Excellence, you will combine deep technical execution with strong ownership of service quality, operational readiness, and capability maturity

What You Will Do

• Design, implement, and operate observability and AIOps capabilities for cloud-native and hybrid environments, supporting reliable, production-grade services

• Lead the onboarding of early adopter teams and services, defining and applying standards for telemetry, SLIs, SLOs, and alerting in real-world systems

• Work hands-on with engineering, SRE, and operations teams to gather requirements and translate them into actionable observability and automation solutions

• Build and maintain telemetry pipelines, dashboards, and alerting, leveraging OpenTelemetry to deliver meaningful insights and reduce operational noise

• Run and evolve observability services in Kubernetes environments, using Helm and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), integrating with ITSM, ticketing and event management systems

What You Bring

• 5+ years of hands-on experience in observability, SRE, platform, or reliability engineering, operating and supporting production systems

• Experience building or scaling observability capabilities, ideally in greenfield or early-stage environments, and turning requirements into working solutions

• Strong practical knowledge of modern observability practices, including OpenTelemetry, metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerting

• Solid experience with cloud-native environments, operating Kubernetes-based workloads using Helm and Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform)

• Experience with common observability toolchains (such as Grafana and Elastic Stack), with scripting or automation skills considered a plus

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska  at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

SIX ci spinge alla trasformazione dei mercati finanziari. Ingegnere di Osservabilità Zurigo Senior|fino al 40% lavorando da casa possibile | Reference 7664 L'Ingegnere di Osservabilità Senior è un ruolo pratico focalizzato sulla costruzione e sulla fornitura di osservabilità e AIOps come capacità e servizio di ingegneria condivisa. Contribuirai a stabilire come l'osservabilità è progettata, implementata e consumata tra i team, guidando i primi onboarding e modellando standard pratici, processi e modi di lavoro. Lavorando a stretto contatto con team di piattaforme, prodotti e applicazioni, tradurrai i requisiti in soluzioni di osservabilità attuabili, implementare e gestire le funzionalità principali e migliorare continuamente come le intuizioni, l'allerta e l'automazione supportano servizi affidabili. Come core contributor del Centro di eccellenza per le operazioni di osservazione e di interoperabilità, combinerai una profonda esecuzione tecnica con una forte proprietà della qualità del servizio, della prontezza operativa e della maturità delle capacità Cosa farai
• Progetta, implementare e gestire funzionalità di osservabilità e interoperabilità per ambienti cloud-nativi e ibridi, supportando servizi affidabili e di qualità produttiva
• Guidare l'onboarding di team e servizi di primo adozione, definire e applicare standard per telemetria, SLI, SLO e allertare in sistemi reali
• Lavorare con i team ingegneristici, SRE e operativi per raccogliere i requisiti e tradurli in soluzioni di osservazione e automazione efficaci
• Costruire e mantenere condotte telemetriche, cruscotti e avvisi, sfruttando OpenTelemetry per fornire informazioni significative e ridurre il rumore operativo

jobs.title: Guided Tours & BME Events Internship (Morning Schedule)

titleByLocale.en: Guided Tours & BME Events Internship (Morning Schedule)
titleByLocale.fr: Visites guidées et événements BME Stage

jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Guided Tours & BME Events Internship (Morning Schedule)

Madrid |  Flexible Working Model | Reference 8004

Are you studying and do you have skills in the field of events management, communication and public relations? Are you interested in the Communication and Marketing sector and looking for an interesting internship to learn more about financial sector?
If your answer is yes, our Events and Conferences team, responsible for events and guided tours at the Palacio de la Bolsa, would like to meet you.

We are looking for a bright and dedicated person who enjoys working in a team and wants to do a morning internship at BME, here you will provide hands-on assistance in the Events and Conferences area. The function will be based at the Palacio de la Bolsa de Madrid (Plaza de la Lealtad, 1).

Don't hesitate and apply now with your CV in English.

What You Will Do

• carry out the guided tours, oversee mailbox and answer inquiries for guided tours, administrating and managing all incoming requests (mail/telephone)

• collaboration in the development of the materials and speeches for the guided tours, acquiring knowledge and history related to the stock market and its surroundings (Stock Exchange Palace)

• support the event managers in all aspects of event management (planning, preparing, execution, event material, invitation and registration management, etc.)

• provide ad hoc support to the events team in their daily work

• on-Site support at events

What You Bring

• studies in Marketing, Communication, Tourism, Bussines Administration or Event Organization

• ability to work in a dynamic and global environment with excellent organizational and communication skills

• strong organizational skills and personal flexibility

• willingness to collaborate and work autonomously paired with good time management skills

• very good level of spoken and written English and Spanish (B2 minimum)

• experience in hosting virtual events is an advantage

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Senior Enterprise Architect
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Enterprise Architect

Warsaw |  100% | Reference 8036

Do you want to shape enterprise-wide processes in a complex and regulated environment?
Are you passionate about aligning business and IT through structured process management and architecture?

Our Enterprise Architecture team defines and governs the architectural landscape across business and IT domains, ensuring alignment between strategic objectives, business processes, and IT capabilities. In this role, you will contribute to the design and evolution of enterprise-wide processes and collaborate closely with domain architects, product teams, and business stakeholders. Acting as a trusted advisor to the CIO and IT leadership, you will help ensure that IT decisions deliver measurable value, comply with governance standards, and support long-term scalability and resilience.

What You Will Do

• contribute to the design and evolution of enterprise architecture, with a strong focus on process management and process architecture

• support and drive process modelling initiatives using BPMN 2.0

• help ensure alignment between business processes, IT systems, and architectural standards

• collaborate with stakeholders across business and IT to define and improve end-to-end processes

• contribute to architecture governance and standards, supporting consistency and regulatory alignment

What You Bring

• experience in enterprise architecture, with increasing responsibility in process management and architecture

• solid understanding of process modelling, including exposure to BPMN 2.0

• broad interest or experience across business, application, data, and technology domains

• experience in the financial services industry or other regulated environments is a plus

• master’s degree in a scientific field; PhD is an advantage

• fluent in English (both verbal and written); German is a plus

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec  at +41583998611 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Senior Enterprise Architect
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Enterprise Architect

Zurich |  80-100% | Reference 8038

Are you passionate about shaping the evolution of enterprise architecture in a complex and highly regulated environment?

Our Enterprise Architecture team defines and steers the architectural landscape across business and IT domains, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities, regulatory expectations, and long-term value creation. In this role, you will contribute to the development and governance of end-to-end architectures across business, application, data, and technology domains. You will act as a trusted advisor to senior IT and business stakeholders, supporting decision-making, driving consistency, and strengthening the overall architecture discipline.

What You Will Do

• develop and evolve enterprise architecture across multiple domains (business, application, data, technology)

• support and challenge IT and business initiatives to ensure alignment with architectural principles and strategic objectives

• act as a sparring partner for senior stakeholders, including IT leadership, product teams, and domain architects

• contribute to architecture governance, standards, and decision-making processes

• facilitate alignment between business capabilities, IT solutions, and regulatory requirements

• support the definition and communication of architectural roadmaps and target states

• drive transparency and consistency across architectural artefacts and practices

What You Bring

• solid experience in enterprise architecture or a comparable role with exposure to multiple architecture domains

• broad understanding of business processes, applications, data, and infrastructure landscapes (not limited to one specialization)

• ability to operate in a complex, regulated environment and balance governance with delivery needs

• strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and challenge constructively at senior levels

• structured thinking with a pragmatic and outcome-oriented mindset

• experience in financial services or other regulated industries is a plus

• master’s degree in a scientific or technical field; advanced degrees are a plus

• fluent in English; German is an advantage

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec  at +41583998611 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

• sviluppare e sviluppare l'architettura aziendale in più settori (business, applicazioni, dati, tecnologia)
• sostenere e sfidare le iniziative IT e business per garantire l'allineamento con i principi architettonici e gli obiettivi strategici
• agire come partner di riferimento per gli stakeholder senior, tra cui leadership IT, team di prodotti e architetti di dominio
• contribuire alla governance dell'architettura, standard e processi decisionali
• facilitare l'allineamento tra capacità aziendali, soluzioni IT e requisiti normativi
• sostenere la definizione e la comunicazione di
• una solida esperienza nell'architettura d'impresa o un ruolo comparabile con l'esposizione a molteplici domini di architettura
• una vasta comprensione dei processi aziendali, delle applicazioni, dei dati e dei paesaggi infrastrutturali (non limitata ad una specializzazione)
• la capacità di operare in un ambiente complesso e regolamentato e di bilanciare la governance con le esigenze di erogazione
• una forte capacità di gestione delle parti interessate, con la capacità di influenzare e sfidare in modo costruttivo a livelli senior
• Pensiero strutturato con una mentalità pragmatica e orientata ai risultati

Zurich, Madrid |  up to 40% home office possible | Reference 8010

Are you motivated by bringing structure, quality, and efficiency to client-facing sales activities? Do you enjoy coordinating across teams, managing multiple stakeholders, and ensuring that client communications and sales processes run smoothly? Then we would like to hear from you.

jobs.title: C++ Software Engineer
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

C++ Software Engineer

Madrid |  Work from home up to 40% | Reference 7650

Are you interested in the world of Finance and IT? Do you have experience as a developer and enjoy working on innovative projects and services? Then, become part of our dynamic and collaborative development team and work on IT projects for the Exchanges Business Unit in Spain and Switzerland. As part of this team you will work on an agile, dynamic and flexible environment

What You Will Do

• Become a part of team that develops the Market data distribution service for the Swiss and Spanish Stock Exchanges

• Develop backend applications using C++ / Linux stack.

• Ensure the operational service level and stability of application. Manage application lifecycle and budget.

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes, and CI/CD pipelines.

What You Bring

• A minimum of 5 years of experience in C++ / Linux programming with accent on development of high-performance network servers.

• Experience in management of the application lifecycle, including development, maintenance, regulations, security and budget.

• Basic knowledge Market data.

• Experience and knowledge of CI/CD (GitLab, Artifactory), Ansible, Linux Shell and Python programming.

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a team and collaborative mindset.

• Fluent in English (both verbal & writing), German is a plus.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Treasury Manager (80 - 100%)
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Treasury Manager (80 - 100%)

Zurich |  80-100% | Reference 8013

Are you an experienced Treasury Manager with IT affinity? Are you familiar with the treasury related tasks in the day-to-day operations, especially cash management and FX hedging? Do you want to further develop these activities and processes and bring in your expertise? Then apply as a Treasury Manager to join our treasury team in Zurich.

Our Treasury team is looking for a Treasury Manager to support and oversee treasury operations and financial risk management activities across the organization. In this role, you will act as a key link between Treasury, Finance, Banking Partners, and other internal stakeholders. You will contribute to efficient cash and liquidity management, support strategic treasury initiatives, and help ensure transparency, compliance, and consistency across all treasury processes.

What You Will Do

• Take responsibility in the day-to-day treasury operations (e.g. cash management, bank relationship management, hedging, etc.)

• Maintain and develop the Treasury Management System

• Foster collaboration with in- and external stakeholders and identify opportunities to optimize treasury activities and processes

• Participate in strategic treasury projects of SIX Group

What You Bring

• Degree in business administration, finance/accounting or related studies, further qualifications are a plus

• Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in a treasury / corporate finance / cash management function, preferably in an international environment

• Solid understanding of day-to-day treasury operations such as cash and liquidity management, interest- and FX hedging, intercompany financing, liability management and bank relationship management (including KYC-documentation)

• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with excellent organizational skills

• IT affinity / experience with treasury management systems (preferably ITS from Reval/ION, SAP and 360T)

• Very good language skills in German and English (verbal and writing), Spanish is a plus

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska  at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

• Mantenere e sviluppare il Sistema di Gestione del Tesoro
• Promuovere la collaborazione con stakeholder interni ed esterni e individuare opportunità di ottimizzare attività e processi di tesoreria
• Partecipare a progetti strategici di tesoreria di SIX Group What You Bring
• Laurea in amministrazione aziendale, finanza/contabilità o studi correlati, ulteriori qualifiche sono un plus
• Minimo 3 anni di esperienza rilevante in una funzione di tesoreria / finanza aziendale / gestione del contante, preferibilmente in un ambiente internazionale
• Solida comprensione di Operazioni di tesoreria quotidiane come gestione del contante e della liquidità, copertura degli interessi e delle FX, finanziamento interaziendale, gestione della responsabilità e gestione dei rapporti bancari (compresa la documentazione KYC)
• Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente veloce con eccellenti competenze organizzative

jobs.title: Cyber Security Resilience Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Cyber Security Resilience Operations Specialist

Warsaw |  up to 40% working from home | Reference 7950

The Cyber Security Resilience Operations Specialist supports the day-to-day operation of the Cyber Security Resilience services, with a strong focus on service desk activities, operational follow-up, and audit support.

The role acts as the first operational layer for File Integrity Monitoring (FIM), Secure Configuration Baseline (SCB), and Vulnerability Management, relieving senior engineers and analysts from administrative, evidentiary, and coordination tasks while ensuring consistency, quality, and audit readiness.

What You Will Do

• Operational & Service Desk Support

• Act as the primary point of contact for service desk requests and tickets related to: File Integrity Monitoring (FIM), Secure Configuration Baseline (SCB / CIS Benchmarks), Vulnerability Management activities

• Triage, track, and coordinate operational tickets, ensuring timely handling and clear communication with stakeholders.

• Perform initial analysis and validation of findings (e.g. expected vs. unexpected changes, status of vulnerabilities, baseline deviations) before escalation.

• Maintain operational documentation, runbooks, and FAQs related to Cyber Security Resilience services.

• Tool-Based Operational Activities

• Operate and support Cyber Security Resilience tooling on a daily basis, including retrieving data, validating results, and supporting reporting activities.

• Assist in maintaining data quality and consistency across FIM, SCB, and Vulnerability Management tools.

• Support recurring operational tasks such as: Report generation, Status checks, Evidence extraction, Follow-up tracking

• This role is not responsible for tool engineering, rule development, or architecture, but requires a solid understanding of how the tools work and how results should be interpreted.

• Audit & Compliance Support

• Actively support internal and external audit activities (e.g. FINMA, DORA, internal audits) by extracting audit evidence directly from Cyber Security Resilience tools, ensuring evidence is complete, traceable, and aligned with audit requests, supporting responses to audit questions in coordination with senior team members.

• Maintain structured audit evidence repositories and support continuous audit readiness.

• Help standardise and streamline evidence collection processes to reduce broader team workload.

• Coordination & Stakeholder Support

• Liaise with infrastructure, platform, and operations teams on operational clarifications and ticket follow-ups.

• Support the Cyber Security Resilience team by absorbing operational overhead, allowing engineers and specialists to focus on analysis and improvement initiatives.

• Escalate operational risks, recurring issues, or data gaps to senior team members in a structured manner.

What You Bring

• Solid foundational understanding of cyber security concepts, particularly: Vulnerability management, Secure system configuration / CIS Benchmarks, File integrity and change monitoring

• Hands-on experience working with security or infrastructure tooling, ideally in an operational or service-oriented role.

• Familiarity with ticketing systems, SLAs, and operational support models.

• Experience supporting audits, compliance activities, or evidence collection is a strong advantage.

• Structured, detail-oriented, and reliable in execution.

• Comfortable working with operational data, evidence, and repetitive tasks while maintaining quality.

• Able to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Proactive in identifying inefficiencies or improvement opportunities in operational processes.

• English Fluency

• German advantage

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa  at .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: IT Commercial Coordinator
jobs.description:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

IT Commercial Coordinator

Warsaw |  Up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 8015

Are you passionate about IT technologies and interested in working in a highly dynamic environment? Join the Costs & Vendors team, where you will help manage costs and compliance for our global IT infrastructure and workplace. You will collaborate with internal and external partners to deliver services for the global IT of SIX.

What You Will Do

• Support the financial steering of global IT infrastructure products (budget planning, forecasting, cost transparency)

• Act as a single point of contact for internal stakeholders and coordinate IT procurement requests and clarifications

• Support contract and license management activities (renewal tracking, documentation, basic compliance checks)

• Prepare reports and maintain operational processes (purchase orders, demand verification, renewals, documentation)

What You Bring

• First experience in IT product management, service-, contract- or license management

• Basic financial understanding (budgeting, forecasting, cost allocation) and strong attention to detail

• Strong analytical skills and interest in IT infrastructure and how services are delivered

• Willingness to learn licensing models and understand their commercial impact

• Skilled in Power BI reporting, automation and the use of artificial intelligence

• Fluent in English (both verbal & writing), German and/or Spanish are a plus

• Growth mindset, open to change, and motivated to take on more responsibility step-by-step

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa 538 562 645

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.
