jobs.description: SIX drives the transformation of financial markets. What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Senior Corporate Administration Lead London |  hybrid working 60/40 | Reference 7954 Job Introduction Are you driven by strong governance and confident operating in regulated environments? Do you enjoy combining strategic oversight with hands on delivery? REGIS-TR are looking for a Senior Corporate Administration Lead to sit at the heart of the organisation’s governance and regulatory framework, working closely with senior leaders, the Board and external partners. The role offers high visibility and real influence, spanning corporate governance, outsourcing oversight, claims management and risk. You will lead critical processes, ensure regulatory compliance and drive continuous improvement, while acting as a trusted adviser across the business and delivering assurance with precision and judgement. What You Will Do •    Manage financial oversight and supplier relationships, including invoice validation, payment reconciliation, tax compliance, banking arrangements and effective vendor controls. •    Lead the outsourcing framework, owning policy implementation, managing third party providers, managing contracts, and monitoring performance against regulatory and service standards. •    Own claims management and risk oversight, acting as the focal point for claims activity and leading the annual Corporate Affairs risk review and mitigation planning. •    Act as a key Corporate Affairs partner for REGIS-TR, working with internal and external stakeholders to ensure regulatory compliance, including regular and ad-hoc FCA reporting, and smooth delivery of governance priorities. •    Manage the annual accounts process, coordinating with Finance colleagues and the statutory auditor to ensure that the annual accounts and Directors’ report are prepared and approved according to agreed timescales What You Bring •    University degree in economics, finance, banking and/or a comparable education •    While not essential, knowledge of SAP would be considered a distinct advantage •    Superb organisational skills, flexible, result oriented, fast acting •    Excellent communication skills; customer and service orientation •    Language: Fluent English mandatory; knowledge of an additional language would be advantageous (particularly German or Spanish) If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills  at +44 207 550 5407 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background. What We Offer Flexible Work Models We trust our employees and offer a work environment that is well-balanced, productive and fosters success.

jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Site Reliability Engineer

Warsaw |  100% | Reference 7652

Do you want to work in a highly dynamic environment? We seek a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join our SRE Department in Warsaw, responsible for driving automation and reliability, owning CI/CD pipelines, and managing incident response. Be part of a team that values collaboration, trust, innovation, and continuous improvement. We are looking for a professional with very strong Shell scripting and Python skill set to bring to the team

What You Will Do

• Drive automation and reliability across platforms to reduce manual work and improve operational efficiency.

• Own CI/CD pipelines and release processes, ensuring secure and scalable delivery of applications.

• Handle incident response and collaborate with development teams to maintain system stability.

• Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues to ensure high availability and performance.

• Participate in Scrum ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

What You Bring

• Degree in Computer Science or related field with 5+ years in DevOps/SRE roles in containerized environments.

• Strong experience with Linux and container technologies such as Docker, Podman, and Kubernetes/OpenShift, Shell scripting and Python

• Deep understanding of CI/CD practices and tools like Kafka, GitLab CI, Ansible, ArgoCD, and Helm.

• Excellent verbal and written English communication skills for effective collaboration across teams.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills  at +44 207 550 5407 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Developer Platform Engineer (Windows/Linux)
jobs.description:
SIX impulsa la transformación de los mercados financieros.

Lo que nos hace diferente, nos impulsa a avanzar: entre raíces locales y relevancia global, somos una mezcla única de tradición y futuro, de cimientos y crecimiento. Apreciamos el valor de mentes brillantes y las inspiramos a crecer con sus ideas. Da forma al futuro de las finanzas con nosotros.

Developer Platform Engineer (Windows/Linux)

Madrid, Warsaw |  Up to 40% working from home possible | Referencia  8031

We are seeking a Developer Experience Engineer to join our centralized DevOps Tools Team. As a Developer Experience Engineer, you define and configure development environments that software engineers rely on every day. You focus on creating reliable, secure, and consistent developer profiles including IDEs to command‑line tooling and possible CI/CD integration.

Working closely with platform, security, and product engineering teams, you continuously improve the developer experience by reducing friction, increasing automation, and enabling engineers to focus on building high‑quality software.

What You Will Do

• Design, develop, and maintain developer client tools such as CLIs, IDE configurations and local development environments.

• Standardize and automate developer onboarding and local setup across Linux and Windows.

• Integrate client tools with source control, CI/CD pipelines, artifact repositories and package managers.

• Partner with security and compliance teams to ensure secure, policy‑compliant developer environments.

• Act as a technical point of contact for engineering teams, gathering feedback and translating it into tooling and end-to-end developer workflow improvements.

• Document tools, workflows, and best practices to enable self‑service and adoption at scale.

What You Bring

• A strong background in software engineering, DevOps, Docker, platform engineering or developer productivity.

• Solid programming skills in at least one language such as Python, Bash, Powershell or TypeScript.

• Experience working with CI/CD systems and integrating local tooling with build and release pipelines.

• Hands‑on experience with build tools and dependency management, Package managers (e.g. npm, pip, Maven), Linux and Windows environments (preferred).

• A strong focus on developer experience, usability and automation.

• Clear communication skills and the ability to document and explain technical solutions.

If you have any questions,  check out our  FAQ page  or call Agnieszka Leputa at +48 538 562 645

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Senior IT Governance Officer

titleByLocale.fr: Agent principal de la gouvernance des TI

jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior IT Governance Officer

Warsaw |  working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 7983

Do you want to play a key role in shaping technology governance to enable business objectives in a complex and regulated environment? Are you motivated by improving decision making, transparency, and accountability across IT?

If so, our Information Technology team would like to hear from you.

As an IT Governance Officer, you will play a central role in defining and embedding IT governance practices that align technology investments with business strategy. Acting as a trusted advisor to the CIO and IT leadership, you will help ensure that IT decisions deliver measurable value, comply with governance standards, and support long term scalability and resilience.

What You Will Do

• lead the definition and maintenance of policies and frameworks for enterprise-wide IT Governance.

• support the CIO organization in steering governance, ensuring alignment with IT Governance principles, standards, and long-term scalability objectives.

• facilitate IT steering committees and governance boards, preparing decision making artefacts, documenting outcomes, and promoting accountability.

• provide expert input to senior risk and compliance committees on technology governance, operational resilience, outsourcing, and third-party risk.

• drive awareness and change initiatives to embed a strong governance culture across IT and business departments.

• promote continuous improvement within IT by encouraging standardization, documentation, and knowledge sharing across teams.

• Take a more active role in shaping governance frameworks, facilitating governance boards and steering committees, and providing expert input to senior risk, compliance, and decision‑making forums.

What You Bring

• master’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.

• relevant professional experience in IT governance, enterprise architecture, or a related discipline, ideally in a financial services or regulated environment. (The scope of responsibilities and level of autonomy will be adapted based on experience.)

• understanding of IT governance and service management frameworks such as COBIT, ITIL, and ISO 38500.

• proven ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments and facilitate effective decision making at senior management level.

• strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to bridge technical and business perspectives.

• fluency in English; German or Spanish is an advantage.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec  at +41583998611 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Senior Quantitative Analyst
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Quantitative Analyst

Zurich, London, Madrid |  working from home up to 40% | Reference 8047

Do you want to work in a highly dynamic environment? Are you passionate about trading? Then our Products team of SIX wants to hear from you!

We are a highly specialized team responsible for the development and financial impact of the exchange. You work closely with various internal stakeholders to support quantitative research, analytics and the development of analytics data products for our clients. The Quant Research & Data Products team within the Products team is tasked with initiatives across asset classes.

What You Will Do

• Drive quantitative research and analytics of order book dynamics to promote trading of existing products and services.

• Provide research and market analysis to identify trends for future initiatives and to monitor the maturity and direction in which launched services are developing.

• Support the team in the monetization of data by developing new analytics data products.

• Develop and maintain close relations with stakeholders both externally (clients, peers, competitors, providers) and internally (sales, business intelligence, data management and colleagues from other SIX business units).

What You Bring

• Top academic profile in finance, economics, statistics, or any quantitative discipline.

• At least 2 years of capital markets experience in quantitative research or trading, deep market microstructure knowledge.

• Highly rigorous, research-oriented and self-motivated person who delivers high-quality work consistently.

• Strong command of Python, SQL and data analysis packages.

• English is required, Spanish and German are highly useful.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills  at +44 207 550 5407 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in english.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX ci spinge alla trasformazione dei mercati finanziari. Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Valorizziamo le menti brillanti e li ispiriamo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi. Senior Quantitative Analyst Zurigo, Londra, Madrid | lavorando da casa fino al 40% | Reference 8047 Vuoi lavorare in un ambiente altamente dinamico? Sei appassionato di trading? • Guidare la ricerca quantitativa e l'analisi delle dinamiche del portafoglio ordini per promuovere il trading di prodotti e servizi esistenti.
• Fornire ricerche e analisi di mercato per individuare le tendenze per le iniziative future e per monitorare la maturità e la direzione in cui si stanno sviluppando i servizi lanciati.
• Sostenere il team nella monetizzazione dei dati sviluppando nuovi prodotti di dati analitici.
• Sviluppare e mantenere strette relazioni con le parti interessate sia esternamente (clienti, coetanei, concorrenti, fornitori) che internamente (vendite, business intelligence, gestione dei dati e colleghi di altre sei business unit). Cosa Portate
• Profilo accademico superiore in finanza, economia, statistica o qualsiasi disciplina quantitativa.
• Almeno 2 anni di esperienza sui mercati dei capitali in ricerca quantitativa o di trading, conoscenza profonda delle microstrutture di mercato.
• Persona altamente rigorosa, orientata alla ricerca e auto-allievo che offre un lavoro di alta qualità in modo coerente.
• Forte comando di Python, SQL e pacchetti di analisi dei dati.
• Inglese è richiesto, spagnolo e tedesco sono altamente utili. Se avete domande, controllare la nostra pagina FAQ o chiamare Anthony Mills al +44 207 550 5407. Per questo posto di lavoro accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette in inglese. La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere le domande indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

Office Assistant and Event Coordinator

Warsaw |  100% office based position | Reference 8006

We are looking for an organized and proactive Office Assistant & Event Coordinator to support daily office operations in Warsaw while delivering high-quality internal and external events. This role combines administration, logistics, and communication to ensure a smooth and engaging workplace experience.

What You Will Do

• manage day-to-day office administration, including supplies, equipment, and vendor coordination

• ensure a safe, clean, and well-functioning workspace while supporting reception and onboarding logistics

• plan and deliver internal events such as town halls, team activities, and engagement initiatives

• support external events, client visits, and leadership meetings, including logistics and vendor coordination

• drive clear office communication and maintain event calendars, budgets, and documentation

• strong organizational and multitasking skills with high attention to detail

• service-oriented mindset with a proactive and reliable approach

jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

Software Engineer

Zurich |  Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 8028

Der Name «debiX» spricht für sich, denn die Zusammensetzung von «debit» und «experience» zielt auf unsere gemeinsame Ambition: Wir vereinfachen das Bezahlen für die Schweiz. Als zentrale Plattform ermöglicht debiX mit Apple- und Google-Pay zu bezahlen, Interaktion durch mobile Apps, Erkennung von Kartenbetrug und weitere innovative Lösungen für die Kartenverwendung der Zukunft. Mit deinem Fachwissen leistest du einen wesentlichen Beitrag für die Entwicklung einer modernen Plattform. Durch den DevOps-Ansatz gewährleisten wir die hohe Stabilität unserer Services. Bei uns zählt Offenheit, Zusammenarbeit und eine positive Fehlerkultur. Werde Teil unseres agilen Teams und gestalte mit, wie ein grosser Teil der Schweizer Bevölkerung bezahlt.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Product Owner und den Stakeholdern konzipierst und implementierst du komplexe Features für den Schweizer Finanzplatz

• In einem selbstorganisierten Scrum Teams treibst du die kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Entwicklungsprozessen und Zusammenarbeit voran

• Du lebst den DevOps-Gedanken und übernimmst Verantwortung für den stabilen Betrieb

• Du stellst durch Code Reviews, automatisierte Tests und Best Practices eine hohe Softwarequalität sicher und wirkst aktiv an deren Weiterentwicklung mit

Das bringst du mit

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit modernen Java- und Web-Technologien

• Teamplayer, der Ideen einbringt und Arbeitsergebnisse gerne präsentiert

• Pluspunkte: Erfahrung mit Angular oder vergleichbaren Frameworks, Event Streaming (z. B. Kafka), OpenShift oder Observability/Monitoring

• Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec  at +41583998611 .

jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Head Clearing Product & Business Development

Madrid, London, Zurich |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7862

SIX Securities Services operates the processes downstream of securities trading including clearing, settlement, custody, securities finance and trade reporting. As part of SIX Securities Services, SIX Clearing plays a key role in the European post-trade value chain, offering highly diversified CCP clearing across several asset classes and services with access to multiple trading platforms across Europe. Operating out of Madrid, Zurich and Oslo, SIX Clearing has a truly pan-European footprint.

As Head of Product & Business Development – Clearing you will be responsible for the end-to-end product and growth agenda of SIX’s clearing services across multiple asset classes. You will lead two specialised teams—Product Management and Business Development—each headed by an experienced team lead. In this senior role, you shape clearing strategy, drive growth initiatives, ensure product competitiveness, and act as a key interface to clients, trading venues, regulators, and internal stakeholders. You are a member of the Clearing Management Committee and contribute directly to the strategic direction of the clearing business.

What You Will Do

• Lead Product Management and Business Development for all clearing products across five asset classes, managing two team leaders and overall team performance.

• Define and execute the clearing product strategy and roadmap, ensuring competitiveness in terms of coverage, connectivity, pricing, and service levels.
Identify and drive growth opportunities, including new market segments, trading venue connections, partnerships, and interoperability initiatives, with ownership of business cases and regulatory processes.

• Act as senior business interface and escalation point for strategic clearing members, trading venues, and key partners, closely aligned with the Executive Team and Sales.

• Represent Clearing at senior internal and external forums, including the Clearing Management Committee, regulatory and industry working groups, and selected client events.

What You Bring

• University degree in economics, finance, business, engineering, or a related field; advanced degree is a plus.

• Extensive experience in post-trade financial market infrastructure, clearing, exchanges, or related financial services. As a clearing expert you fundamentally understand the industry and product mechanisms of Liquidity, Collateral, Balance Sheet Optimisation and Margin across different asset classes.

• You naturally build senior strategic relationships both internally and externally, translating ideas into roadmaps and operational execution. Track record of fostering strong commercial relationships with customers, partners and suppliers.

• Strong strategic, analytical, and commercial mindset, with experience owning product strategies, business cases, and growth initiatives.

• An entrepreneurial nature with an intuitive understanding of how to create value in a highly competitive business. A thought leader with a strong affinity for continuous innovation and an ability to synthesise customer sentiment, competitor initiatives and trends in both direct and adjacent markets, in order to stay ahead of - and ideally, harness - industry disruption

• Proven people-leadership skills, including managing senior professionals and team leads in a complex, cross-functional, international environment and excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills at senior management, client, and regulatory level.

• Excellent oral and written English skills; German and/or Spanish is an advantage.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Accounts Receivable Accountant

Warsaw |  up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 7913

Are you ready to accelerate your career in a place where expertise meets innovation?

If accounting and financial operations spark your energy, you’ll feel right at home with us.

SIX Global Business Solutions - proudly based in central Warsaw and recognized as one

of Poland’s Best Workplaces  - drives key financial processes for the global SIX organization.

Our Customer Processing Team (Accounts Receivable) manages the full spectrum of AR activities

with accuracy, ownership, and a strong team spirit.

We are currently seeking an Accounts Receivable Accountant who is motivated to develop professionally within accounting and finance and contribute to the seamless and efficient execution of our processes.

What You Will Do:

• Execute daily operational tasks, including applying incoming and outgoing payments, managing customer and subledger accounts, reconciling bank statements, resolving unallocated payments, and processing customer invoices

• Take part in monthly and year-end closing activities, ensuring deadlines are met and data accuracy and quality are maintained

• Provide support to internal departments and external customers by handling inquiries and requests

• Participate in the dunning and collection process

• Contribute to ad-hoc tasks and analyses

• Ensure process documentation is regularly reviewed and updated

What you bring:

• A collaborative mindset combined with analytical skills and a high level of attention to detail

• Minimum of 3 years of experience in Accounts Receivable

• Very good command of English; German will be a great plus

• Solid understanding of financial accounting principles

• Educational background in finance and accounting will be an advantage

• Experience working with SAP FI/SD and very good practical knowledge of MS Office

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa  at .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Customer Support Agent

titleByLocale.fr: Agent de soutien à la clientèle

jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Customer Support Agent

Leudelange |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7853

As a Customer Support Agent, you play a key role in delivering high‑quality, timely support to customers in Luxembourg and globally, contributing to service excellence and continuous improvement within an international environment.

What You Will Do

• Handle customer inquiries and incidents across SIX products and data services, ensuring timely, high‑quality resolution through end‑to‑end request handling via ticketing tools, email, calls and meetings.

• Manage and maintain operational relationships with key customers.

• Conduct root cause analysis, identify recurring issues and contribute to their sustainable resolution.

• Support business growth by engaging with new customers, products, services and SIX initiatives

What You Bring

• Experience in financial markets, with exposure to asset servicing, middle/back office, market data products and regulatory topics (e.g. MiFID, ESG).

• Strong customer orientation with excellent communication and presentation skills.

• Analytical, investigative and solution‑driven mindset.

• Interest in continuous learning to support service excellence across a global product and data portfolio.

• Fluent in English and French (written and spoken); Dutch is a plus. Interest in automation and AI‑related topics is an advantage; prior AI knowledge is a plus, but not a must‑have.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

What We Offer

Flexible Work Models

We trust our employees and offer a work environment that is well-balanced, productive and fosters success.

Personal Development

You will benefit from a culture of continuous learning and feedback. Your personal growth is supported through an extensive learning offering.

Agile Working Methods

Whether through scrum or design thinking,

we solve exciting tasks together in teams.

Apply now »
 </d

jobs.title: IT Governance Officer
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

IT Governance Officer

Warsaw |  Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 7982

Do you want to play a key role in shaping technology governance to enable business objectives in a complex and regulated environment? Are you motivated by improving decision making, transparency, and accountability across IT?

If so, our Information Technology team would like to hear from you.

As an IT Governance Officer, you will play a central role in defining and embedding IT governance practices that align technology investments with business strategy. Acting as a trusted advisor to the CIO and IT leadership, you will help ensure that IT decisions deliver measurable value, comply with governance standards, and support long term scalability and resilience.

What You Will Do

• lead the definition and maintenance of policies and frameworks for enterprise-wide IT Governance.

• support the CIO organization in steering governance, ensuring alignment with IT Governance principles, standards, and long-term scalability objectives.

• facilitate IT steering committees and governance boards, preparing decision making artefacts, documenting outcomes, and promoting accountability.

• provide expert input to senior risk and compliance committees on technology governance, operational resilience, outsourcing, and third-party risk.

• drive awareness and change initiatives to embed a strong governance culture across IT and business departments.

• promote continuous improvement within IT by encouraging standardization, documentation, and knowledge sharing across teams.

What You Bring

• master’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.

• relevant professional experience in IT governance, enterprise architecture, or a related discipline, ideally in a financial services or regulated environment. (The scope of responsibilities and level of autonomy will be adapted based on experience.)

• understanding of IT governance and service management frameworks such as COBIT, ITIL, and ISO 38500.

• proven ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments and facilitate effective decision making at senior management level.

• strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to bridge technical and business perspectives.

• fluency in English; German or Spanish is an advantage.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec  at +41583998611 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Senior Sales Manager
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Sales Manager

London |  hybrid working 60/40 | Reference 7964



Do you want to work in a fast-moving, client-facing market environment?
SIX Financial Information is seeking a commercially driven, client-centric Account Manager to manage and grow a portfolio of key accounts within our Financial Information business in the UK market. This is a quota-bearing role focused on deepening client relationships, driving retention and expansion, and delivering sustainable revenue growth across an existing client base.
You will act as the senior relationship owner for a defined portfolio of growth and priority accounts, building strong partnerships with key stakeholders across the buy- and sell-side. Success in this role requires a strong understanding of financial market workflows across front, middle, and back office functions, and the ability to translate SIX Financial Information’s product suite into clear, tangible commercial value.

What You Will Do

•           Own and develop senior client relationships across a portfolio of complex accounts, acting as the primary trusted advisor to key stakeholders
•           Lead strategic account planning, defining short- and long-term growth strategies to drive retention, revenue expansion, and minimise churn
•           Manage the full commercial lifecycle, including renewals, pricing, negotiations, and contract execution
•           Identify and execute upsell and cross-sell opportunities, increasing deal size and overall client adoption
•           Build and maintain a high-quality pipeline with accurate forecasting, pipeline coverage tracking, and path-to-goal analysis
•           Engage in consultative, solution-led selling by translating client workflows and data needs into value propositions, whilst acting as the voice of the client internally

What You Bring

•           5+ years’ experience in account management or sales within financial information, market data, or a related industry, with a proven quota track record
•           Strong understanding of financial markets, including buy-side and sell-side workflows and data requirements
•           Experience managing complex institutional clients and navigating multi-stakeholder environments effectively
•           Strong consultative and solution-selling skills, with the ability to articulate clear value propositions
•           Excellent relationship management, communication, negotiation, and presentation skills across all organisational levels
•           Proactive, organised, and results-driven approach, with strong pipeline management discipline and ability to collaborate across international teams

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills  at +44 207 550 5407 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Testing Manager
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Testing Manager

Madrid, Barcelona |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8056

We are looking for an experienced and motivated Testing Lead in Madrid to join our Clearing IT team. This is an exciting opportunity for a QA professional who thrives in complex environments and wants to play a key role in shaping quality across business-critical initiatives. In this role, you will define, implement, and lead testing strategies and quality standards for projects and change requests, helping to deliver high-quality, compliant software in a collaborative and international setting. Fluency in English is mandatory, and proficiency in Spanish is highly preferred.

We are looking forward to meet you. Apply now with your CV in English.

What You Will Do

• Define and drive a comprehensive test strategy covering functional, non-functional, and regression testing to support successful project delivery and high-quality outcomes.

• Lead QA activities for change requests related to continuous enhancements and maintenance within Clearing applications, ensuring quality standards are met and releases are delivered with confidence throughout the year.

• Establish and oversee an effective defect management process in JIRA, working closely with development and business teams to ensure timely resolution and continuous quality improvement.

• Facilitate regular test management meetings to review progress, resolve concerns, and keep stakeholders aligned on delivery goals and change priorities.

• Identify risks early and proactively escalate critical issues to project management to support informed decisions and timely resolution.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams across multiple locations, fostering seamless teamwork and aligning testing activities with project milestones and release plans.

What You Bring

• A minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in test management, including responsibility for medium to large or complex projects, with end-to-end ownership of test strategy, execution oversight, defect management, and quality assurance governance.

• A proven track record of successfully leading test management activities across multiple releases or projects and delivering strong quality outcomes in complex environments.

• Solid understanding of Waterfall, Agile, and SAFe methodologies, with the flexibility to adapt testing approaches to different delivery models.

• Experience in coordinating and leading a team of more than six testers, providing guidance, structure, and support to achieve shared quality goals.

• Strong proficiency in JIRA for test management, change request tracking, and transparent documentation of defects, resolutions, and project progress.

• Fluency in both verbal and written English.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Fixed Income Surveillance Specialist
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Fixed Income Surveillance Specialist

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8058

BME is the operator of all securities markets and financial systems in our country and is part of the SIX Group. In Fixed Income surveillance team we are looking for a person to join the team to cover the daily basis. As a Fixed Income operation technician you will be learning how to manage our data bases and our trading platforms: AIAF, MARF and SENAF. You will work in a motivated, dynamic environment in which we are responsible for Fixed Income Market.

What You Will Do

• Registration and maintenance of issues in the data base

• Surveillance of the Fixed income Markets (checking positions, trades, market abuse, doing EOD files & procedures)

• Management of Members and system connections

• Collaboration on the testing version updates

• Monitorization and helpdesk support to Members, both national and international

What You Bring

• Bachelor's degree in Economics, Business Administration or any related field. Studies related with financial sector or Capital Markets will be a plus

• A minimum of 2 years of experience in the financial sector and in an operational or back office area

• Good written and oral level of English and Spanish, minimum a B2

• Thorough, proactive and decisive person, with good teamwork skills

• Attention to details and patience personality to avoid committing errors

• Availability to work in weekly rotatory shifts (from 8:00h to 16:30h and from 9:30 to 18:00 h)

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Senior Java Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Java Full Stack Engineer

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8029

We’re looking for a Senior Java Full Stack Engineer to join our agile, self-organized global engineering team building high-quality products for our Repo customers. You’ll work on exciting projects within the financial markets, collaborate across teams, and help deliver robust features end to end. If you’re passionate about modern tech, teamwork, and delivering impact, we’d love to hear from you.

Please apply with your CV in English. We’re looking forward to meet you.

What You Will Do

• Working in an agile team to analyze and develop new features and improvements for greenfield project

• Coordinate technical integrations with external teams and systems: MQ, Elasticsearch, relational databases, External APIs, OpenShift

• Create and maintain technical documentation and architecture artifacts

• Contribute to the implementation of DevOps concepts

What You Bring

• Extensive Experience: You possess over 5 years of experience in developing and implementing modern 3-layer web architectures using Java technologies such as Messaging, Spring Boot, JEE, and Hibernate/JPA, Kafka, Redis, Junit, liquibase, Spring (security, cache, batch). You also have solid experience designing and developing UIs with Angular.

• Modern Development Practices: You are proficient in utilizing contemporary software development concepts and tools, including Scrum, Docker, OpenShift, CI/CD, and Domain-driven Design.

• Problem-Solving Skills: You excel under pressure, demonstrating a result-oriented and analytical mindset that enables you to quickly identify and resolve issues.

• Team Collaboration: You are highly motivated, a team player, and possess strong interpersonal skills that facilitate effective collaboration.

• Language Proficiency: You are fluent in both verbal and written English.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: IT Product Manager
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

IT Product Manager

Warsaw |  Up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 8016

Are you passionate about IT technologies and interested in working in a highly dynamic environment? Join the Costs & Vendors team, where you will help manage costs and compliance for our global IT infrastructure and workplace. You will collaborate with internal and external partners to deliver services for the global IT of SIX.

What You Will Do

• Support the financial steering of global IT infrastructure products by actively managing cost transparency, identifying deviations and driving improvements

• Act as a single point of contact for internal stakeholders and challenge stakeholders, procurement and finance where appropriate

• Support contract and license management activities by ensuring transparency and identifying risks and optimization opportunities

• Prepare reports and further develop processes and improve transparency and efficiency (purchase orders, demand verification, renewals, documentation)

What You Bring

• 2-5 years of experience in IT product management, service-, contract- or license management

• Strong financial understanding (budgeting, forecasting, cost allocation) and ability to interpret cost structures

• Strong analytical and conceptual skills with ability to derive insights and recommendations and a good understanding of IT infrastructure and service delivery

• Good understanding of licensing models and their commercial impact

• Advanced skills in Power BI reporting, automation and the use of artificial intelligence

• Fluent in English (both verbal & writing), German and/or Spanish are a plus

• Growth mindset, open to change, and motivated to take on more responsibility step-by-step

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa at +48 538 562 645

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Business Analyst

Warsaw |  working from home up to 40% | Reference 7639

Introduction

Do you like working close to real data and seeing the impact of your work in production?
In this role, you help keep our products running on clean, timely, and trusted reference data.
You work hands on with data sources from onboarding to release and make sure they are mapped, validated, and ready for use.
You take real ownership, work on data that matters, and quickly build strong expertise in areas like identifiers, taxonomies, and data quality.
This is a great role if you enjoy combining analysis, structure, and practical execution.

What you will do

•    Gather and document requirements for instrument and issuer reference data
•    Analyse data feeds and define mappings, data models, and rules to build a reliable golden copy
•    Implement validation checks, reconciliation, and controls including handling of duplicates and exceptions
•    Ensure secure data transfer and manage ongoing data changes
•    Identify risks early and drive improvements or automation opportunities
•    Collaborate with Product, IT, and Operations, and support testing, documentation, and releases

What you will bring

•    2 to 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst in financial or reference data

jobs.title: Performance Test Engineer (Linux)
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Performance Test Engineer (Linux)

Madrid, Barcelona |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7888

Are you passionate about modern technology and eager to work in an agile, highly dynamic environment at the heart of the stock exchange trading business? Join our team that integrates and operates the low latency matching application within the trading platform. Your role will be to design, implement, automate and document latency, throughput, performance, capacity, failover tests. In this position as a Performance Test Engineer you will work closely with testing, infrastructure, network, security teams.

What You Will Do

• Design, implement, and execute performance/NFT strategies for a matching application, with a focus on latency, throughput, jitter, failover, and load testing across pre prod and prod like environments.

• Build and automate test harnesses, scenarios, and continuous integrations to continuously assess performance, regression test results, and scalability; leverage Ansible and scripting for repeatable tests in various environments.

• Visualize results of NF testing, create performance dashboards using different tools (e.g., Grafana), produce reports and recommendations for engineering and other stakeholders.

• Collaborate with functional testers, infrastructure, network, and database teams to model realistic market conditions, tune systems, and design non-functional test cases; contribute to release readiness and change planning.

• Troubleshoot and analyze issues from low level network packets to OS and application behavior; drive root cause analysis and propose performance optimizations and mitigations.

What You Bring

• Strong Linux engineering background with excellent Bash scripting and Python programming skills complemented with C/C++.

• Experience implementing and executing fully automated non-functional tests; ability to simulate market like traffic patterns.

• Very good understanding of networks and various factors that impact low latency systems.

• Hands on experience with DevOps practices and toolchains relevant to automation and continuous testing (e.g., Ansible, GitLab, CI, Airflow, Openshift/ArgoCD); familiarity with version control and artifact handling will be a plus.

• Analytical mindset with excellent troubleshooting skills across layers; collaborative communicator comfortable working with infrastructure, network, application, and security teams; readiness to occasionally work outside normal hours for major tests or incidents.

• Very good verbal and written English.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Atlassian Cloud Administrator (Jira & Confluence)
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - impulsa la transformación de los mercados financieros y pertenece a SIX, el tercer grupo bursátil más grande de Europa.

Lo que nos hace diferente, nos impulsa a avanzar: entre raíces locales y relevancia global, somos una mezcla única de tradición y futuro, de cimientos y crecimiento. Apreciamos el valor de mentes brillantes y las inspiramos a crecer con sus ideas. Da forma al futuro de las finanzas con nosotros.

Atlassian Cloud Administrator (Jira & Confluence)

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Referencia  8033

Provide strategic ownership of Jira and Confluence Cloud as enterprise platforms, ensuring they are secure, scalable, and continuously improved to meet evolving customer and organizational needs. Acts as the highest escalation point for complex issues and as a technical authority with expert knowledge of Atlassian Marketplace apps, including BigPicture and ScriptRunner. Provides 3rd‑level support and drives platform optimization through advanced configuration, automation, and AI capabilities to enhance user experience, delivery efficiency, and decision‑making.

What You Will Do

• Provide strategic ownership of Jira and Confluence Cloud as enterprise platforms, ensuring they are secure, scalable, and continuously improved to meet evolving customer and organizational needs.

• Acts as the highest escalation point for complex issues and as a technical authority with expert knowledge of Atlassian Marketplace apps, including BigPicture and ScriptRunner.

• Provides 3rd level support and drives platform optimization through advanced configuration, automation, and AI capabilities to enhance user experience, delivery efficiency, and decision making.

What You Bring

• Expert administration of Jira Software, JSM, and Confluence Cloud in enterprise environments

• Proven experience providing 3rd‑level (L3) support for Atlassian products (strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to work independently on high‑impact issues)

• Advanced use of Marketplace apps (e.g. BigPicture, ScriptRunner) and strong experience in their administration

• Very good technical English skills (written and spoken), suitable for technical documentation and collaboration with international stakeholders

• Automation & AI enablement (Jira Automation, Rovo, AI features) to improve efficiency and user experience

• Solid understanding of integrations, data flows, and limitations within Atlassian Cloud

Si tienes alguna duda, consulta nuestra página de preguntas frecuentes (FAQ) o contacta con Yuliya Stoyko   +34 917095993 .

Para esta vacante sólo aceptamos solicitudes directas.

La diversidad es importante para nosotros. Por lo tanto, estamos deseando recibir solicitudes independientemente de cualquier contexto personal.

jobs.title: Senior System Engineer (80 - 100%)
jobs.description:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior System Engineer (80 - 100%)

Zurich, Warsaw |  Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 8023

Do you want to shape the future of digital workspaces in a highly dynamic enterprise environment? Are you passionate about virtualisation platforms and cloud-based end-user computing? Then our Digital Workspace Virtualisation team at SIX wants to hear from you.

We are an international team of experts responsible for the operation, optimisation and continuous development of solutions for our colleagues, partners and customers. You will lead by example through hands-on engineering and collaboration across teams, while consistently demonstrating the SIX values of Customer Focus, Collaboration, Ownership and Trust.

What You Will Do

• Technical ownership for the operation and engineering of virtual privileged access workspaces (PAW)

• Integrate identity, authentication and security requirements

• Drive the evolution from client-hosted to a scalable, centralised solution on server hypervisors

• Participate in broader virtual workspace and remote access initiatives

• Support planned out-of-hours activities and participate in on-call rotations for major incidents

What You Bring

• Expert level experience with Citrix CVAD and NetScaler in enterprise environments

• Strong experience with hardened Windows 11 golden images, identity and authentication (e.g. IdPs, PKI, FAS, FIDO2)

• Exposure to PAW/PAM systems and/or Azure Virtual Desktop

• Fluent in English (verbal and written). German and/or Spanish is a plus

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska  at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer - Golang
jobs.description:
SIX impulsa la transformación de los mercados financieros.

Lo que nos hace diferente, nos impulsa a avanzar: entre raíces locales y relevancia global, somos una mezcla única de tradición y futuro, de cimientos y crecimiento. Apreciamos el valor de mentes brillantes y las inspiramos a crecer con sus ideas. Da forma al futuro de las finanzas con nosotros.

Platform Engineer - Golang

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Referencia  8032

Are you interested in automating a modern and secure environment with strong focus on process automation and service integration? We invest in bright minds, in their ideas, knowledge and development. We do that by combining our best sides. Are you eager to work in an environment where passion, trust, and collaboration are paramount? If you are passionate about automation, eager to leverage technology, ready to make a significant impact, and excited about accelerating our transition towards self-service and infrastructure as code, then our Service Automation team wants to hear from you.

You will join the Service Automation product team, which is responsible for collecting Service Automation demands within our area. This includes gathering automation use cases, developing shared building blocks, and creating a state-of-the-art abstraction/orchestration layer. Stay updated with the latest industry trends and advancements in automation technologies, keeping a great user experience for our internal customers in mind.

What You Will Do

• Design, develop, and maintain GoLang-based microservices with REST and gRPC interfaces.

• Collaborate on infrastructure automation using Terraform and Azure Container Apps.

• Collaborate with cross-functional product teams to enhance the process, role and capabilities of automation, utilizing standardized techniques.

• Develop innovative automation strategies that improve productivity, reduce errors, and enhance system performance.

• Assist and Consult internal customers with their automation needs.

What You Bring

• Proven experience in GoLang development (3+ years), ideally in microservices architecture.

• Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform/OpenTofu) and CI/CD pipelines.

• Solid understanding of Platform Engineering, DevOps and cloud practices, including CI/CD (GitLab), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/OpenTofu) and Azure deployments.

• Fluent in English.

• Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration.

Si tienes alguna duda, consulta nuestra página de preguntas frecuentes (FAQ) o contacta con Yuliya Stoyko   +34 917095993 .

Para esta vacante sólo aceptamos solicitudes directas.

La diversidad es importante para nosotros. Por lo tanto, estamos deseando recibir solicitudes independientemente de cualquier contexto personal.

jobs.title: Senior Corporate Governance Counsel
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Corporate Governance Counsel

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8090

We are looking for a Corporate Governance Counsel to help strengthen corporate governance across the Group. The role is of mid-level seniority, with room for learning and development.

In this role, you will work closely with the Head Legal Governance and the Governance teams in Switzerland and Spain. You will help shape governance standards, support legal entity management, and improve key governance processes across an international group.

We are looking forward to hear from you. Don't hesitate and apply now with your CV in English.

What You Will Do

• Assist the Company Secretary and Assistant Company Secretary in the scheduling, preparation and running of the meetings of the Board of Directors, prepare the minutes, manage the sharing of information according to internal practices and regulations, manage secretariat formalities (notary, filing, registers etc..).

• Provide governance advice relative to the governance of legal entities, including newly established entities, acquired entities, divestitures, joint ventures and in the context of re-organizations and assist in the review of governance documents, including Articles of Association, Organization Rules, and Competency Rules.

• Advise on signature authority and support the development of related policies and processes.

• Create and maintain templates for governance-related documentation and improve key governance workflows and support and drive governance projects and AI-based process improvements.

• Maintain document management and SharePoint structures and ensure proper archiving and draft legal memos, prepare presentations, and deliver training to internal stakeholders. Draft powers of attorney and support notarial and registration processes.

• Work with colleagues across functions and jurisdictions to deliver practical governance solutions and assist in the establishment of standards and processes to ensure a coordinated and efficient governance of all legal entities within the Group.

• Participate in the execution of strategic projects as they relate to legal entities and governance.

What You Bring

• A minimum of 5 years of corporate governance experience in Spain.

jobs.title: Senior IT Risk and Control Officer

titleByLocale.it: Senior IT Risk and Control Officer
titleByLocale.en: Senior IT Risk and Control Officer
titleByLocale.de: Senior IT Risk and Control Officer
titleByLocale.fr: Agent principal des risques et du contrôle de la TI

jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior IT Risk and Control Officer

Warsaw |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8061

Are you passionate about finance and modern technology? Do you have good organizational skills? If yes, this is the right place for you.

You coordinate the IT Risk and controls out of a central team distributed between Switzerland, Spain and Poland, to ensure appropriate risk methodology and assessment and in-time remediation of deficiencies. You also help the operational SMEs to assess their Risks and Internal Control processes. Together with the diverse and motivated team you help to simplify and optimize the GRC landscape, develop templates and guidance as well as train and educate the organization towards the regulated environment and the need of GRC controls.

What You Will Do

• Responsible for the proper risk identification, review and management together with operational SMEs

• Assure stakeholder appropriate reporting on the risk and control universe together with LoD2

• Actively develop the GRC tool landscape and help to automate and raise the maturity

• Manage and improve the ICS (Internal Control System) control catalogue and its testing, ensuring completeness, accuracy and alignment with regulatory requirements

• Act as the single point of contact for IT GRC topics and take a coordinator and interface role including training and awareness for line management, SME, projects and GRC initiatives

What You Bring

• Several years of experience in IT Risk & Control, Audit and Operations

• Interdisciplinary knowledge of IT processes, operations and architectures

• Proven experience in IT risk identification, assessment and mitigation strategies

• Understanding and applying IT risk, audit and control methodologies

• Good organizational skills, structured way of working and the ability to identify problems and solve them systematically

• Very good written and spoken English skills. German and/or Spanish are a plus.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec  at +41583998611 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Post-Trade Services Specialist

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8046

Do you have experience in Post Trading or in the Security Services area in financial markets? Are you enthusiastic about exciting projects in the financial industry and enjoy working with internal and external clients in an international environment?

We are looking for a Post-Trade Services Specialist to join our team in Madrid.

What You Will Do

• Management of corporate actions/income, settlement, proxy voting and tax reclaim services on foreign securities across different markets, both within and outside the T2S platform

• Collaborate in the definition of functional requirements for various requests addressed to IT departments

• Support the implementation of new tools and processes, monitoring, planning and passing knowledge to the involved teams and area

• Cooperate closely with internal and external customers, understand their needs, evaluate and eventually implement any necessary adjustments in processes

What You Bring

• A minimum of 2 years of experience in Securities services e.g. in banking and finance and post trading

• Strongly valued: experience in international teams and with foreign securities across different markets, both within and outside the T2S platform

• Good communication skills as well as systematic and accurate working methods

• Participation on projects in the post trading area

• Reliability and willingness to constantly learn and implement new products and processes

• Very good verbal and written skills in Spanish and English

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Java Backend Developer
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Java Backend Developer

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7485

Join our TPA Dev team in Madrid and grow into a Calypso Developer. You’ll start as a seasoned Java backend engineer and receive structured training on Calypso, used for Triparty Collateral Management and Repo Services at SIX. This is an on-the-job learning path: you’ll build production-grade services while deepening your knowledge of Calypso and the post-trade domain.

What You Will Do

• Design, build, and operate backend services in Java for collateral management and repo workflows, evolving into Calypso customizations and integrations.

• Develop robust, multi-threaded services and APIs using Java 8+ and Spring Boot; expose and consume RESTful interfaces.

• Implement event-driven integrations (e.g., messaging/streaming) between Calypso and internal/external systems.

• Model, optimize, and maintain relational data structures; write efficient SQL and work with ORM frameworks (Hibernate/JPA).

• Contribute to solution design and architecture, ensuring scalability, resiliency, and observability across services.

• Collaborate closely with business analysts, Calypso specialists, and SRE/DevOps to deliver reliable, compliant, and secure solutions.

• Participate in the full SDLC: requirements, estimation, implementation, code reviews, testing (unit/integration), deployment, and production support.

• Embrace infrastructure and platform standards (e.g., Linux RHEL 8+, containerization, CI/CD) and help automate build/test/deploy pipelines.

• Learn and extend Calypso: configuration, workflows, data models, APIs, and custom components to support triparty collateral and repo processes.

• Contribute to continuous improvement: reduce technical debt, improve system performance, strengthen security, and enhance developer productivit

What You Bring

• 4+ years of hands-on software engineering experience with a strong focus on multithreaded backend development in Java (Java 8+).

• Proficiency with Spring Boot, RESTful API design, and building reliable distributed services.

• Strong database skills: SQL expertise, sound schema design, and experience with Hibernate/JPA.

• Solid understanding of object-oriented design, event-driven architectures, and messaging patterns.

• Familiarity with Linux environments (RHEL 8+), and comfort working with modern CI/CD practices and tooling.

• Understanding of financial markets and post-trade infrastructure; exposure to collateral or repo is a plus.

• Growth mindset: positive, result-driven, quality-focused, and systematic thinker with a problem-solving attitude.

• Collaborative communicator, team-oriented, resilient under pressure; ability to work in a cross-functional, multicultural environment.

• Language skills: English required; German and/or Spanish are a plus.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Senior Account Manager (80 -100%)
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Account Manager (80 -100%)

Zurich |  up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 7956

We are looking for an experienced Senior Sales & Relationship Manager to join our Sales Switzerland & Liechtenstein team in Zurich. In this role, you will act as a senior and trusted partner for clients, owning relationships end to end and driving sustainable revenue growth through upselling and cross selling within existing accounts.

This position is designed for a seasoned professional who operates with a high degree of autonomy, carries a significant sales target, and is ready to actively shape client relationships and commercial

What You Will Do

• act as a senior, trusted point of contact for clients, managing complex inquiries, commercial discussions, and stakeholder interactions with confidence.

• build, develop, and deepen long term relationships at all levels within client organizations, including senior and executive stakeholders.

• proactively identify and execute upselling and cross selling opportunities within existing accounts to drive revenue growth against ambitious targets.

• own the onboarding of new clients and ensure a seamless transition into our services, laying the foundation for long term partnerships.

• develop a deep understanding of client needs, market trends, and regulatory dynamics to anticipate challenges and deliver tailored, value adding solutions.

• collaborate closely with internal teams to ensure high quality delivery, client satisfaction, and a consistently positive client experience.

• represent the company as a senior ambassador at client meetings, executive touchpoints, industry events, and conferences.

• manage and continuously develop a robust sales pipeline, providing accurate forecasting, transparent reporting, and clear visibility on commercial performance.

What You Bring

• over 10 years of experience in sales and/or client relationship management, ideally within financial services or a complex B2B environment.

• proven ability to independently manage, grow, and retain client portfolios, including carrying and delivering against significant revenue targets.

• strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to engage at senior and executive levels.

• high level of ownership, accountability, and commercial acumen, combined with a proactive and results driven mindset.

• excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast paced environment.

• fluency in English and German required; additional languages are an advantage.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska  at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX ci spinge alla trasformazione dei mercati finanziari. Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo una miscela unica di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Valorizziamo le menti luminose e li ispiriamo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi. Senior Account Manager (80-100%) Zurigo | fino al 40% lavorando da casa possibile | Reference 7956 Stiamo cercando un esperto Senior Sales & Relationship Manager per entrare nel nostro team Sales Svizzera & Liechtenstein a Zurigo. In questo ruolo, agirai come partner senior e di fiducia per i clienti, possedendo relazioni finiscono per finire e guidando la crescita sostenibile dei ricavi attraverso upselling e cross selling all'interno di conti esistenti. Questa posizione è progettata per un professionista esperto che opera con un alto grado di autonomia, porta un target di vendita significativo, ed è pronto a modellare attivamente i rapporti con i clienti e commerciale Cosa farete
• agire come un punto di contatto senior, fidato per i clienti, gestire complesse indagini, discussioni commerciali e interazioni con fiducia degli stakeholder.
• sviluppare, sviluppare e approfondire relazioni a lungo termine a tutti i livelli all'interno delle organizzazioni dei clienti, compresi i soggetti senior e dirigenti.
• identificare ed eseguire in modo proattivo le opportunità di upselling e cross selling all'interno dei conti esistenti per guidare la crescita dei ricavi verso obiettivi ambiziosi.
• possedere l'onboarding di nuovi clienti e garantire una transizione senza soluzione di continuità nei nostri servizi, gettando le basi per partnership a lungo termine.
• sviluppare una profonda comprensione delle esigenze dei clienti, delle tendenze di mercato e delle dinamiche normative per anticipare le sfide e fornire soluzioni personalizzate e di valore aggiunto.
• collaborare strettamente con team interni per garantire un'elevata qualità di consegna, soddisfazione del cliente e un'esperienza cliente costantemente positiva.
• rappresentare l'azienda come senior ambassador in riunioni dei clienti, touchpoint esecutivi, eventi industriali e conferenze.
• gestire e sviluppare continuamente una robusta pipeline di vendita, fornendo previsioni accurate, reporting trasparente e una chiara visibilità sulle performance commerciali. Cosa Portare
• oltre 10 anni di esperienza nella gestione delle vendite e/o delle relazioni con i clienti, idealmente all'interno di servizi finanziari o un ambiente B2B complesso.
• capacità comprovata di gestire, crescere e mantenere in autonomia i portafogli dei clienti, anche portando e consegnando contro importanti obiettivi di reddito.
• forte comunicazione, negoziazione e capacità di gestione delle parti interessate, con la fiducia di impegnarsi a livello senior ed esecutivo.
• elevato livello di proprietà, responsabilità e acumen commerciale, combinato con una mentalità proattiva e orientata ai risultati.
• eccellenti competenze organizzative e la capacità di gestire più priorità in un ambiente dinamico e veloce.
• fluenza in inglese e tedesco richiesto; ulteriori lingue sono un vantaggio. Se avete domande, controllare la nostra pagina FAQ o chiamare Beata Czyzewska a +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49. Per questo posto di lavoro accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette. La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

descriptionByLocale.de:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran. Was uns auszeichnet, treibt uns voran: zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, von Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen die Intelligenz und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Kommen Sie und gestalten Sie die Zukunft der Finanzen mit uns. Senior Account Manager (80 -100%) Zürich, bis zu 40% von zu Hause aus möglich arbeiten, Referenz 7956 Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Senior Sales & Relationship Manager, der sich unserem Sales Switzerland & Liechtenstein Team in Zürich anschließt. In dieser Rolle werden Sie als Senior und vertrauenswürdiger Partner für Kunden agieren, deren Beziehungen enden und nachhaltiges Umsatzwachstum durch Upselling und Crossselling innerhalb bestehender Konten fördern. Diese Position ist für einen erfahrenen Profi konzipiert, der mit einem hohen Grad an Autonomie arbeitet, ein signifikantes Umsatzziel verfolgt und bereit ist, Kundenbeziehungen und kommerzielle Aktivitäten aktiv zu gestalten.Was Sie tun werden
• Sie fungieren als Senior, vertrauenswürdiger Ansprechpartner für Kunden, verwalten komplexe Anfragen, kommerzielle Gespräche und Interaktionen mit Stakeholdern mit Vertrauen.
• langfristige Beziehungen auf allen Ebenen innerhalb von Kundenorganisationen aufbauen, entwickeln und vertiefen, einschließlich hochrangiger und ausführender Stakeholder.
• proaktiv Upsell- und Cross-Selling-Möglichkeiten innerhalb bestehender Konten identifizieren und umsetzen, um das Umsatzwachstum gegenüber ehrgeizigen Zielen zu fördern.
• das Onboarding neuer Kunden besitzen und einen nahtlosen Übergang in unsere Dienstleistungen gewährleisten, die Grundlage für langfristige Partnerschaften bilden.
• ein tiefes Verständnis der Kundenbedürfnisse, Markttrends und regulatorischen Dynamiken entwickeln, um Herausforderungen zu antizipieren und maßgeschneiderte, wertsteigernde Lösungen zu liefern.
• eng mit internen Teams zusammenarbeiten, um eine qualitativ hochwertige Lieferung, Kundenzufriedenheit und eine konsequent positive Kundenerfahrung zu gewährleisten.
• das Unternehmen als Senior Botschafter bei Kundentreffen, Executive Touchpoints, Branchenveranstaltungen und Konferenzen vertreten.
• eine robuste Vertriebspipeline verwalten und kontinuierlich entwickeln, die genaue Prognosen, transparente Berichterstattung und klare Sichtbarkeit bei der kommerziellen Leistung bietet. Was Sie bringen
• über 10 Jahre Erfahrung im Vertriebs- und/oder Kundenbeziehungsmanagement, ideal innerhalb von Finanzdienstleistungen oder einem komplexen B2B-Umfeld.
• bewährte Fähigkeit, Kundenportfolios unabhängig zu verwalten, zu wachsen und zu halten, einschließlich der Durchführung und Umsetzung von erheblichen Umsatzzielen.
• starke Kommunikation, Verhandlungen und Stakeholdermanagement-Fähigkeiten, mit dem Vertrauen, auf Senior- und Executive-Ebene zu engagieren.
• hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, Rechenschaftspflicht und kommerziellem Scharfsinn, kombiniert mit einer proaktiven und ergebnisorientierten Denkweise.
• ausgezeichnete organisatorische Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten in einer dynamischen, schnelllebigen Umgebung zu verwalten.
• Sprachkenntnisse in Englisch und Deutsch erforderlich; weitere Sprachen sind ein Vorteil. Bei Fragen können Sie sich unsere FAQ-Seite ansehen oder Beata Czyzewska unter +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 anrufen. Für diese Stelle akzeptieren wir nur direkte Bewerbungen. Diversity ist uns wichtig. Daher suchen wir Bewerbungen unabhängig von der persönlichen Herkunft.
