• agir comme un point de contact supérieur et de confiance pour les clients, gérer des demandes complexes, des discussions commerciales et des interactions avec les intervenants avec confiance.
• établir, développer et approfondir des relations à long terme à tous les niveaux au sein des organisations clientes, y compris les acteurs supérieurs et exécutifs.
• identifier et exécuter de manière proactive des opportunités de vente à haut niveau et de vente croisée dans les comptes existants pour stimuler la croissance des revenus par rapport à des objectifs ambitieux.
• posséder l'intégration de nouveaux clients et assurer une transition transparente dans nos services, en jetant les bases de partenariats à long terme.
• développer une compréhension approfondie des besoins des clients, des tendances du marché et de la dynamique réglementaire pour anticiper les défis et fournir des solutions adaptées et à valeur ajoutée.
• collaborer étroitement avec les équipes internes pour assurer une prestation de haute qualité, la satisfaction de la clientèle et une expérience client toujours positive.
• représenter l'entreprise comme ambassadeur principal lors des réunions de clients, des points de contact exécutifs, des événements industriels et des conférences.
• gérer et développer en permanence un solide pipeline de ventes, fournissant des prévisions précises, des rapports transparents et une visibilité claire sur les performances commerciales.
• la capacité éprouvée de gérer, de développer et de conserver de façon indépendante les portefeuilles de clients, y compris en réalisant et en exécutant des objectifs de recettes significatifs.

• le haut niveau d'appropriation, de responsabilité et d'aumône commerciale, combiné à une attitude proactive et axée sur les résultats.

• maîtrise de l'anglais et de l'allemand requis; les langues supplémentaires sont un avantage. jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer - Data Availability
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Site Reliability Engineer - Data Availability

Singapore |  working from home up to 40% | Reference 7751

We are looking for a skilled and reliability-driven Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to strengthen our engineering team. In this hybrid role, you will combine hands-on 2nd level support responsibilities with monitoring, automation, and reliability engineering. You will play a key role in ensuring the stability, observability, and continuous improvement of our production systems supporting real-time financial data processing.

What You Will Do

Operational Support & Incident Management

• Provide 2nd level support for production systems and critical business applications.

• Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve incidents and performance issues.

• Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and document findings in a structured manner.

Monitoring, Observability & Automation

•

• Design, implement, and maintain monitoring dashboards.

• Improve alert quality and reduce noise through effective threshold and metric design.

• Analyze logs, metrics, and system behavior to proactively detect anomalies, automate operational processes using Ansible and scripting.

What You Bring

• Operational Mindset & Collaboration

• Proven experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or 2nd level production support.

• Effective communication skills and ability to work with cross-functional teams.

Technical Skills

• Hands-on experience with Elastic Stack and Grafana for monitoring and logging.

• Experience with Ansible for configuration management and automation.

• Experience with Git/GitLab.

• Familiarity with scripting languages.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills  at +44 207 550 5407 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

What We Offer

Flexible Work Models

We trust our employees and offer a work environment that is well-balanced, productive and fosters success.

Personal Development

You will benefit from a culture of continuous learning and feedback. Your personal growth is supported through an extensive learning offering.

jobs.title: Financial Securities Specialist with French
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Financial Securities Specialist with French

Warsaw |  Up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 7907



At SIX, this role offers the opportunity to contribute to a leading financial market infrastructure provider by ensuring the quality and reliability of reference data across funds, fixed income, and shares. Following a structured onboarding, the position focuses on maintaining accurate data, supporting regulatory compliance, and delivering high standards of service to clients. The role combines analytical responsibilities with functional client support in an international and data‑driven environment. It is well suited for candidates interested in financial markets and the core processes that support them.

What You Will Do:

• entering reference data into SIX different databases

• verifying data consistency and performing second-level checks

• providing functional assistance to clients

What You Bring:

• fluent French speaking

• first experience in the financial data industry or a related field is a plus

• knowledge of French and European fund/Fixed Income/Shares regulations

• understanding of the fund/Fixed Income/Shares ecosystem (market players, data distribution systems, Back/Front office concepts)

• SQL language knowledge is a plus

• experience with JIRA and Confluence tools

• higher education background in management/finance (ideally a Master’s degree)

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa at +48 538 562 645

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Head Sales & Account Management for Cards, ATM and TWINT (80 - 100%)

Zurich |  up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 7669

Are you excited about developing strategic client relationships and leading a high‑performing sales team? As Head Sales & Account Management for Cards, ATM and TWINT, you will shape our long‑term growth by defining how we collaborate with our key clients and by building scalable structures that position us for the future. You combine strategic perspective with strong operational execution and create tangible value for our clients in every interaction.

What You Will Do

• Lead, develop and coach a team of 4 Account Managers and build a clear, performance‑driven and transparent sales culture

• Develop and execute a structured client‑development approach, including account planning, pipeline steering and reliable forecasting

• Implement scalable sales processes, CRM standards and data‑driven methods to ensure consistent and efficient client management

• Collaborate closely with Product Management, Support, Onboarding, Finance, Compliance, Marketing, Data Analytics and the Sales Support team in Poland to ensure an integrated client experience

• Manage strategic key accounts end‑to‑end – from opportunity development and stakeholder coordination to long‑term relationship management

What You Bring

• Several years of leadership experience (5+ years) in developing and managing high‑performing B2B sales teams; experience working with near‑shore support teams is an advantage

• Solid B2B sales experience in strategic market development; industry knowledge and an established network in the Swiss debit and credit cards market are a clear benefit

• Ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments and to build long‑term, trust‑based client relationships.

• Strong commercial mindset, excellent storytelling skills, high affinity for AI, and strong analytical and operational capabilities – with the ability to translate market insights into concrete actions and measurable results

• Excellent German and English skills (understanding of Swiss German required); French is an advantage

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska  at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Senior IT Business Manager
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior IT Business Manager

Zurich |  Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 8052

The CIO Office at SIX supports the CIO in steering the IT organization with clarity, focus, and impact. At its core, the Office translates IT strategy into execution, ensures transparency and alignment across IT, and drives delivery of key transformation initiatives.

The role of Senior IT Business Manager is a central, deliberately broad position within this setup. It offers the opportunity to operate at the intersection of strategy, governance, and execution, with direct exposure to the CIO and senior leadership.

What You Will Do

• CIO Enablement & Executive Steering: Support the CIO in steering key IT topics, including preparation of decision materials, management presentations, and strategic narratives

• Governance & Leadership Support: Orchestrate and prepare key governance forums (e.g., Board and leadership formats) and ensure structured follow-up and transparency.

• Strategy Execution: Actively contribute to the execution of the IT and transformation strategy, including managing cross-functional initiatives.

• Cross-functional Orchestration: Connect and coordinate topics across IT and business units, including managing dependencies, priorities, and escalations.

• Ad-hoc Strategic & Operational Topics: Lead and deliver a broad variety of “CIO Enablement” topics (e.g., mandates, RfPs, workshops, communication formats) with high visibility and impact.

• Hands-on Delivery across Levels: Ability to switch between high-level strategic discussions and detailed operational execution while maintaining end-to-end consistency.

What You Bring

• University degree (technology, business, or similar), B.A. or higher.

• 5-10 years of professional experience, ideally in IT, strategy, or transformation environments.

• Proven ability to engage and collaborate with senior stakeholders combined with clear and effective communication.

• Hands-on, structured and pragmatic approach with a strong “can-do” attitude and the ability to independently drive topics to results.

• High commitment and motivation, distinct readiness to take on responsibility.

• Fluency in English is a must; German is a plus.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec  at +41583998611 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Senior Corporate Governance Counsel
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Corporate Governance Counsel

Zurich |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8089

SIX is looking for a Corporate Governance Counsel (100%) to help strengthen corporate governance across the Group. The role is of mid-level seniority, with room for learning and development.

In this role, you will work closely with the Head Legal Governance and the Governance teams in Switzerland and Spain. You will help shape governance standards, support legal entity management, and improve key governance processes across an international group.

The Group accounts for 70 entities, 21 of which are regulated by financial regulators and/or national banks, in, Switzerland, Spain and the UK.

What You Will Do

• Support Board and committee meetings by preparing materials, drafting minutes, managing formalities and shareholder liaisons.

• Advise on corporate governance across the Group, while supporting legal entity matters, including set-up, acquisitions, and reorganisations.

• Review and maintain governance documents by developing policies, templates, and processes, including signature authority.

• Drive governance projects and improve workflows, including the use of AI tools.

• Maintain documentation and ensure proper archiving, while also preparing memos, presentations, and deliver training to stakeholders.

What You Bring

• Have at least 5 years of corporate governance experience in Switzerland.

• Experience in establishing standards and processes across a group of legal entities incorporated in different jurisdictions.

• Write clearly, work in a structured way, and turn complex topics into practical solutions.

• Recognized as a team player with strong collaborative skills, an eye for details and pragmatism.

• Confident using Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word, and you are comfortable working with AI tools.

• Eager to continuously learn and develop & welcome feedback and guidance.

• Fluent in English and German.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec  at +41583998611 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Senior System Engineer
jobs.description:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior System Engineer

Zurich |  80-100% | Reference 8096

Do you want to define and govern how cryptographic keys are secured across a financial enterprise? Are you motivated by combining security, risk, and regulatory requirements into real control frameworks?

Join SIX as a Key Management Security Officer and take ownership of key management governance, ensuring secure and auditable cryptographic controls across critical platforms.

What You Will Do

• Define and enforce key management policies, standards, and controls

• Oversee the full lifecycle of cryptographic keys (generation to destruction)

• Ensure compliance with regulatory frameworks (PCI DSS, FINMA, DORA)

• Support audits and maintain evidence for control traceability

• Assess risks and define mitigation measures for key management environments

What You Bring

• Strong knowledge of cryptography and key lifecycle management

• Experience with HSMs and key management platforms (e.g., Keyfactor, cloud KMS,Securesys,Thales,Entrust)

• Proven background in audit, compliance, or regulated environments

• Strong analytical and stakeholder management skills

• Degree in information security or related field; certifications (CISSP, CISM) are a plus

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec  at +41583998611 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Head Social Marketing
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Head Social Marketing

Zurich, Madrid, Warsaw |  Up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 8062

Are you passionate about shaping strategic social marketing at scale and leading teams through transformation? Do you thrive in an international, global environment and enjoy partnering closely with the business to create measurable impact? Then join our international Digital Communications team as Head of Social Marketing. The role can be based in Warsaw (Poland), Madrid (Spain), or Zurich (Switzerland).

In this role, you will lead our social media team and own the strategic direction of paid and organic social marketing across our channels. With your leadership experience, strategic mindset, and drive for excellence, you will help strengthen our brands SIX and BME, elevate our social marketing maturity, and enable your team to act as trusted advisors to the business.

We invest in the development of our leaders and support you in continuously expanding your skills and capabilities.

As a modern, innovative company at the intersection of technology and finance, SIX offers a wide range of opportunities to make a meaningful impact and fully leverage your potential. We look forward to receiving your application in English.

What You Will Do

• Lead and coach a remotely distributed team of three social media specialists, fostering a strategic approach to social marketing, a consultancy mindset, accountability, and effective delegation.

• Own the end‑to‑end social marketing strategy across paid and organic activities, aligned with business and marketing objectives.

• Establish and continuously improve workflows and templates to ensure scalability, quality, and efficiency across remote collaboration.

• Act as the accountable owner for social marketing outcomes, translating goals into KPIs and measurable performance; includes leading crisis management across social channels when applicable.

• Act as a proactive strategic partner to internal stakeholders and propose solutions in resource‑constrained environments.

What You Bring

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Digital Media, or a related field, with at least 6 years of relevant professional experience in social media marketing.

• Proven experience leading remote or virtual social media teams, with strong online leadership, coaching, and people development skills.

• Deep expertise in strategic social marketing, including paid campaigns, performance measurement, and optimization.

• Demonstrated ability to coach teams toward a consultative way of working, moving beyond purely executional delivery.

• Strong process and transformation mindset, with experience building scalable ways of working in complex organizations; fluent English is required, German language skills are highly preferred but not mandatory.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa at +48 538 562 645

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

titleByLocale.fr: Directeur principal de l'automatisation du marketing

jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Marketing Automation Manager

Warsaw |  Up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 8067

Are you passionate about building marketing automation at an enterprise level and driving measurable business impact? Do you thrive in an international environment and enjoy shaping strategy, customer journeys, and data-driven decisions? Then join our international Digital team as Senior Marketing Automation Specialist.

In this role, you will own and further develop our business Marketing Automation strategy in Marketo, with a strong focus on generating Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) and supporting sales opportunity creation. You will define and optimize lifecycle communications across email and other relevant channels.

You will act as the strategic driver behind targeting, segmentation, personalization, lifecycle design, attribution, and performance measurement. In doing so, you will define business requirements and work closely with IT, Data teams, and the Marketo Application Manager.

With your deep expertise in Marketing Automation, you will also steer and mentor a Junior Marketing Automation Manager.

We invest in the development of our experts and support you in continuously expanding your skills, both strategically and technically.

As a modern, innovative company at the intersection of technology and finance, SIX offers a wide range of opportunities to make a meaningful impact and fully leverage your potential.
We look forward to receiving your application in English.

What You Will Do

• Define and own the end-to-end business Marketing Automation strategy in Marketo, translating business objectives into clear automation use cases, roadmaps and success metrics, while aligning with platform capabilities.

• Define and optimize B2B email marketing and omnichannel engagement strategies, ensuring that nurturing, lifecycle communications, and automated journeys are relevant and aligned with business objectives across the customer journey.

• Design, implement, and optimize marketing automation frameworks (lead scoring, lead qualification, nurturing) and continuously improve targeting, segmentation, and personalization to drive Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs).

• Define and manage attribution models in Marketo, and contribute to holistic performance reporting by connecting Marketo data with Google Data Studio dashboards.

• Act as strategic owner and senior stakeholder interface for Marketing Automation, leading governance across internal teams (Compliance, Marketing, Sales, Tech, Data, IT) and external partners, while steering and and coaching one Junior Marketing Automation Manager.

What You Bring

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Communication, Marketing, Media, Public Relations, or a comparable field.

• 5+ years of experience in Marketing Automation, with proven ownership of enterprise‑scale Marketo setups and the ability to define and drive marketing automation strategy beyond campaign execution.

• Strong experience in B2B email marketing, lifecycle communications and omnichannel campaign orchestration, including segmentation, personalization, testing, engagement optimization and email best practices.

• Deep expert knowledge of Marketo, including architecture, lead scoring and qualification models, lifecycle management, attribution, reporting, and governance, with a strong focus on SQL and sales opportunity generation.

• Analytical and attribution skills, including defining attribution models in Marketo and connecting Marketo data to Google Data Studio dashboards.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa at +48 538 562 645

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi. Ingegnere di software senior Varsavia | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% | Riferimento 8037 Vuoi lavorare in un ambiente altamente dinamico e costruire sistemi di backend affidabili e scalabili? Sei appassionato di Java, sistemi distribuiti e architetture orientate agli eventi? Allora il nostro Backend Engineering Team vuole sentirti. Siamo un team agile e collaborativo responsabile della progettazione e gestione di servizi di backend core che alimentano la nostra piattaforma nell'area Post Trading della SIX Swiss Exchange. Il nostro obiettivo è quello di costruire e mantenere sistemi robusti, scalabili e manutenbili che supportano processi aziendali critici. In questa posizione, lavorerai a stretto contatto con ingegneri software, architetti e team di prodotti per progettare, mantenere e fornire soluzioni backend di alta qualità. Applica ora con il tuo CV in inglese. Cosa farai
• progettare, sviluppare e mantenere i servizi backend e le API REST utilizzando Java, Spring e Spring Boot
• costruire e gestire servizi basati su eventi utilizzando Apache Kafka
• sviluppare e mantenere applicazioni in esecuzione su server applicativi Java come WildFly
• collaborare con gli ingegneri e gli architetti sulla progettazione del sistema, l'architettura e i miglioramenti tecnici
• garantire affidabilità, scalabilità e prestazioni dei sistemi di produzione Che cosa porta
• esperienza molto forte con Java backend sviluppo e moderni principi di design backend
• esperienza con Spring e Spring Boot per la costruzione di microservizi
• esperienza con Kafka o altre piattaforme di messaggistica / event-streaming
• la conoscenza di Wildfly/JBOSS è un grande plus
• la progettazione di API RESTful e il lavoro con database SQL
• alto livello inglese, sia scritto che parlato, per interagire con i nostri colleghi internazionali Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Agnieszka Leputa al numero +48 538 562 645 Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette. La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Senior Software Engineer Warsaw | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8037 Do you want to work in a highly dynamic environment and build reliable, scalable backend systems? Are you passionate about Java, distributed systems, and event-driven architectures? Then our Backend Engineering Team wants to hear from you. We are an agile and collaborative team responsible for designing and operating core backend services that power our platform in the Post Trading area of the SIX Swiss Exchange. Our goal is to build & maintain robust, scalable, and maintainable systems that support critical business processes. In this position, you will work closely with software engineers, architects, and product teams to design, maintain and deliver high-quality backend solutions. Apply now with your CV in English. What You Will Do
• design, develop, and maintain backend services and REST APIs using Java, Spring, and Spring Boot
• build and operate event-driven services using Apache Kafka
• develop and maintain applications running on Java application servers such as WildFly
• collaborate with engineers and architects on system design, architecture, and technical improvements
• ensure reliability, scalability, and performance of production systems What You Bring
• very strong experience with Java backend development and modern backend design principles
• experience with Spring and Spring Boot for building microservices
• experience with Kafka or other messaging / event-streaming platforms
• knowledge of Wildfly/JBOSS is a big plus
• experience designing RESTful APIs and working with SQL databases
• high english level, both writen and spoken, to interact with our international colleagues If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa at +48 538 562 645 For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Sie interessieren sich für Java, verteilte Systeme und ereignisgesteuerte Architekturen? Dann möchte unser Backend Engineering Team von Ihnen hören. • Erstellen und Betreiben von ereignisgesteuerten Diensten mit Apache Kafka
• Entwicklung und Pflege von Anwendungen, die auf Java-Anwendungsservern wie WildFly ausgeführt werden
• Zusammenarbeit mit Ingenieuren und Architekten bei Systemdesign, Architektur und technischen Verbesserungen
• Gewährleistung von Zuverlässigkeit, Skalierbarkeit und Leistung von Produktionssystemen Was du mitbringst
• sehr starke Erfahrung mit Java Backend Entwicklung und modernen Backend Design Prinzipien
• Erfahrung mit Spring und Spring Boot für den Aufbau von Microservices
• Erfahrung mit Kafka oder anderen Messaging / Event-Streaming-Plattformen
• Wissen über Wildfly / JBOSS ist ein großes Plus
• Erfahrung beim Entwerfen von RESTful APIs und Arbeiten mit SQL-Datenbanken
• hohes Englischniveau, sowohl geschrieben als auch gesprochen, um mit unseren internationalen Kollegen zu interagieren Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite oder rufen Sie Agnieszka Leputa unter +48 538 562 645 an Für diese Vakanz akzeptieren wir nur Direktbewerbungen. Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Daher suchen wir nach Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

jobs.title: System Engineer
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

System Engineer

Zurich |  80-100% | Reference 8098

Are you passionate about securing digital ecosystems at scale? Do you want to design and operate missioncritical cryptographic services in a regulated financial environment?

Join our Cryptographic Services team and help build secure, scalable platforms that protect SIX’s core infrastructure. You will work closely with application, infrastructure, and security teams to deliver trusted cryptographic solutions across hybrid environments.

What You Will Do

• Design, implement, and operate enterprise cryptographic services (PKI, HSM, certificates)

• Automate certificate lifecycle and integrate cryptography into applications and CI/CD pipelines

• Contribute to the enterprise cryptographic inventory and visibility across assets

• Support vulnerability remediation and incident resolution for cryptographic components

• Ensure compliance with security standards and regulatory requirements (e.g., PCI DSS, FINMA, DORA)

What You Bring

• Strong expertise in PKI, TLS, HSM, or key management technologies

• Experience with automation, APIs, or infrastructure-as-code

• Understanding of cloud and modern application environments (e.g., Azure, containers)

• Ability to translate security requirements into practical engineering solutions

• Fluent in English (written and spoken)

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec  at +41583998611 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: QA Tester
jobs.description:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

QA Tester

Warsaw |  Up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 7842

Location: Warsaw (hybrid)

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced QA Tester to join our team in Warsaw. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our applications across both project-based initiatives and ongoing change activities. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, applying strong analytical skills, structured testing approaches, and excellent communication to deliver high quality results.

What You Will Do

• Plan, prepare, execute, and document test activities

• Manage all aspects of the QA lifecycle, including defect management & progress tracking

• Develop and maintain high-quality test artefacts using JIRA/Xray and Confluence.

• Collaborate with business and IT stakeholders.

• Estimate test efforts and support tool evaluations to optimize testing efficiency.

• Apply automation and AI-driven testing techniques to improve test coverage

• Work in Agile and SAFE environments, adapting testing practices to evolving needs.

• Manage multiple tasks and priorities while ensuring timely and high quality delivery.

What You Bring

• Proven experience in managing QA activities across projects and change requests.

• Strong understanding of SW testing principles, methodologies, and best practices.

• Structured and methodical approach to testing.

• Practical experience working in Agile and SAFe frameworks.

• Hands-on experience with JIRA/Xray and Confluence for test documentation.

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

• Ability to explain risks, issues, and test results to non technical stakeholders.

• Ability to set priorities, manage deadlines, and handle multiple parallel tasks.

• Skilled in estimating test efforts and evaluating testing tools.

• Fintech experience (reference data or market data processing) .

• Advanced knowledge of data analysis or data processing tools.

• Scripting skills (e.g. python)

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: IT Solution Designer
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

IT Solution Designer

Warsaw, Madrid |  Working form home up to 40% possible | Reference 7776

Do you want to work in a highly dynamic environment? Are you passionate about architecture and technology? Join our growing Architecture Practice as an IT Solution Designer / Application Architect supporting our dynamic teams, shaping the architecture of applications as we transform to meet the ever-evolving demands of our products and business. We are looking for a professional driven by passion for data, technology transformation, and cross-functional collaboration. As a member of our Architecture team, your influence will not just shape the architecture and our engagement across the department, but also help chart the course for our future state.

What You Will Do:

• Design, drive, and maintain end‑to‑end solution architectures in close collaboration with Senior Architects, development teams, and business stakeholders, ensuring alignment with target architecture, principles, standards, and governance.

• Shape and evolve the future‑state architecture and technology roadmap across the landscape, contributing to strategic architectural decisions and long‑term modernization initiatives.

• Support SAFe System Architects within Agile Release Trains by establishing and maintaining the architectural runway to enable continuous delivery, architecture evolution, and emerging business demands.

• Build strong, trust‑based relationships with business stakeholders, developers, and fellow architects to translate business needs into robust, scalable, and well‑documented architectural solutions.

• Ensure adherence to enterprise architecture standards, security, risk, and regulatory requirements, while supporting technology evaluations and the design and delivery of proofs of concept and prototypes.

What you will bring:

• 3+ years in a technical leadership capacity, 5+ years in an architecture capacity, with experience in the global financial services sector, particularly in Financial Information and high-volume Data Management at scale a plus

• Good knowledge of diverse technologies and solution architecture patterns, and with a drive for innovation. Experience with both on-premise and Cloud technologies and architecture paradigms, and the trade-offs between them.

• Understanding of AI technologies, integration patterns and emerging standards, and the foundational capabilities to enable AI growth and adoption

• Proficiency in English is mandatory, both written and spoken. Knowledge of Spanish and German is an advantage

• A vibrant personality and natural collaborator, with the capability to work across diverse teams, and foster strong, extended connections

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec  at +41583998611 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Technical Writer
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Technical Writer

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7879

As a Documentation Specialist (Technical Writer), you support participants of the electronic trading and listing platforms of Bolsas y Mercados Españoles (BME) and SIX Swiss Exchange. In close collaboration with subject‑matter experts, you prepare clear, timely communications for technical contacts at trading participants and maintain documentation products for internal and external clients. You also handle related administrative tasks. The role requires the ability to quickly understand complex topics, particularly when delivering fast and reliable information in emergency situations. You work independently and with a high degree of reliability in a complex operational environment

We are seeking a Technical Writer with a Bachelor’s degree in Technical Communication, Information Technology, Finance, or a related field. The position is full-time position (100%) based in Madrid and involves close collaboration with the Documentation Team in Zurich. Willingness to travel is required.

What You Will Do

• Create and distribute technical notices addressed to participants of Bolsas y Mercados Españoles (BME), SIX Swiss Exchange (SSX), SIX Exfeed, 12H and CONNEXOR.

• Support communication tasks during emergency notifications during exchange trading hours and on weekends during trading platform migrations.

• Create and maintain technical documentation to support the technical help desks of these services.

• Perform various internal documentation tasks, including creating, reviewing, and finalizing documents using Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Adobe Designer.

• Publish content and maintain the Member Section.

What You Bring

• Strong experience in technical writing, document lifecycle management, and structured content creation.

• Proficiency in Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Adobe Designer; Knowledge of SAP CRM and Confluence and expericence with SAFe / Agile project management methodologies is an advantage.

• Excellent English skills; Spanish and German language abilities are considered strong advantages.

• Able to translate complex technical concepts into clear and concise content for various audiences. Solid knowledge of IT‑related topics and familiarity with financial market infrastructure.

• Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and version control. Ability to work reliably under time pressure, including support during trading hours and occasional weekend duties.

• Strong interpersonal skills for collaborating with IT teams, product owners, and operational units.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Senior Solution Architect - Workplace
jobs.description:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Solution Architect - Workplace

Warsaw |  up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 7538

Would you like to help us to transform our IT Infrastructure, drive our cloud journey and bring our services to the next level? Are you passionate about technology? Then, we want to hear from you! As part of SIX IT Infrastructure & Operations, we continuously innovate our customer's experience by providing technically mature, sustainable, and up-to-date services. You will contribute to that by ensuring that our building blocks are fit for purpose and well aligned.

What You Will Do

• Drive the design and integration of workplace solutions into the enterprise IT landscape, ensuring alignment with architectural standards and business objectives

• Lead solution architecture for projects, validating requirements and ensuring compliance with security, risk, and regulatory frameworks

• Define and maintain the digital workplace roadmap, incorporating emerging technologies such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, automation, and zero-trust principles

• Collaborate with IT Competence Centers and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, and user-centric solutions

• Establish measurable success criteria for adoption, compliance, and operational efficiency, and report progress to senior leadership

What You Bring

• Degree in IT or Computer Science; industry certifications (e.g., Microsoft, ITIL) are an advantage

• Proven experience as a Workplace Solution Architect in complex, regulated environments (finance or pharma preferred)

• Expertise in designing and integrating enterprise-grade solutions using M365, Exchange, SharePoint, Intune, and modern workplace technologies

• Strong analytical and consulting skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and manage competing priorities pragmatically

• Excellent written and verbal communication in English for both technical and business contexts; German and/or Spanish is a strong plus

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska  at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

• Lead solution architecture for projects, validating requirements and ensuring compliance with security, risk, and regulatory frameworks
• Define and maintain the digital workplace roadmap, incorporating emerging technologies such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, automation, and zero-trust principles
• Collaborate with IT Competence Centers and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, and user-centric solutions
• Establish measurable success criteria for adoption, compliance, and operational efficiency, and report progress to senior leadership What You Bring
• Degree in IT or Computer Science; industry certifications (e.g., Microsoft, ITIL) are an advantage
• Proven experience as a Workplace Solution Architect in complex, regulated environments (finance or pharma preferred)
• Expertise in designing and integrating enterprise-grade solutions using M365, Exchange, SharePoint, Intune, and modern workplace technologies
• Strong analytical and consulting skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and manage competing priorities pragmatically
• Excellent written and verbal communication in English for both technical and business contexts; German and/or Spanish is a strong plus If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 . titleByLocale.en: AI Solutions Lead - Development Tools (Claude Code)

jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

AI Solutions Lead - Development Tools (Claude Code)

Warsaw, Madrid |  working from home up to 40% | Reference 7548

We’re looking for an AI Solutions Lead - Development Tools (Claude Code) to join our DevOps Tools Team in Warsaw. Your mission: shape how AI transforms the way software gets built at SIX from idea to production code powering the financial markets in Europe and beyond. In this role you define the vision and strategy, design the architecture, evaluate suitable solutions and drive their adoption. You’ll work at the intersection of AI and developer tooling, the internal development platforms and organizational change - putting agentic AI into the hands of product owners, business analysts, architects, testers and developers across the company.

What You Will Do

• Own the AI roadmap for the Software Development Lifecycle — from requirements and design through development and deployment

• Continuously evaluate, benchmark and assess the latest AI tools and platforms

• Prototype and integrate AI-powered workflows when off-the-shelf solutions don't fit, using modern agent frameworks

• Drive enterprise-wide adoption of AI-enabled solutions by designing rollout strategies, running pilots and workshops and tracking measurable adoption outcomes

• as a first project engineer and rollout Claude Code for the Developers

What You Bring

• passion for AI and re-imagining software development

• 5+ years in software engineering and demonstrated experience in Claude Code

• strong understanding of the end-to-end Software Development Lifecycle

• hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools and AI Agents

• ability to drive adoption of new tools and practices across engineering teams, not just make them available

• strong communication and presentation skills, fluent in English

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: BME Events Internship (Afternoon Schedule)

titleByLocale.it: Palazzo BME Eventi Stage (Parcheggio del pomeriggio)
titleByLocale.fr: Palais BME Événements Stage (horaire de l'après-midi)

jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

BME Events Internship (Afternoon Schedule)

Madrid |  Flexible Working Model | Reference 8084

Are you passionate about events and eager to gain hands-on experience in a dynamic environment.  Are you interested in the Financial Industry sector and looking for an interesting internship?

If your answer is yes, our team responsible for events and guided tours at the Palacio de la Bolsa, would like to meet you.

We are looking for a bright and dedicated person who enjoys working in a team and wants to do a afternoon internship at BME, here you will provide hands-on assistance in Events and Hospitality. The function will be based at the Palacio de la Bolsa de Madrid (Plaza de la Lealtad, 1).

Don't hesitate and apply now with your CV in English.

What You Will Do

• Handling and managing incoming requests (mail/telephone)

• Managing incoming enquiries and preparing proposals

• Updating event details in our systems

• Supporting security-related processes such as Guest list coordination, Certificate requests, Setup coordination, documentation and monthly planning

• Supplier coordination

• Assisting with event setup activities (especially afternoon setups)

• Providing hands-on on-site support during events

• Provide ad hoc support to the events team in their daily work

What You Bring

• You are studying Events management, Marketing, Communication or specific training in Event Organization and you have availability for the afternoons (from 14 to 19h Monday to Friday)

• Ability to work in a dynamic and global environment with excellent organizational and communication skills

• Strong organizational skills and personal flexibility

• Willingness to collaborate and work autonomously paired with good time management skills

• Very good level of spoken and written English and Spanish (B2 minimum)

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.it:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari e appartiene a SIX, il terzo più grande gruppo di scambi in Europa. Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi. Palazzo BME Eventi Stage (Parcheggio del pomeriggio) Madrid | Modello di lavoro flessibile | Riferimento 8084 Stai studiando e hai competenze nel campo della gestione degli eventi, della comunicazione e delle relazioni pubbliche? Sei interessato al settore Comunicazione e Marketing e alla ricerca di un interessante stage per saperne di più sul settore finanziario? Se la vostra risposta è sì, il nostro team Eventi e Conferenze, responsabile di eventi e visite guidate al Palacio de la Bolsa, vi incontrerà. Siamo alla ricerca di una persona luminosa e dedicata che si diverte a lavorare in una squadra e vuole fare uno stage pomeridiano a BME, dove fornire assistenza pratica nella zona Eventi e Conferenze. La funzione si baserà al Palacio de la Bolsa de Madrid (Plaza de la Lealtad, 1). Non esitare e applica ora con il tuo CV in inglese. Cosa farai
• effettuare le visite guidate, supervisionare la casella di posta e rispondere alle richieste di visite guidate, amministrare e gestire tutte le richieste in arrivo (mail / telefono)
• collaborazione nello sviluppo dei materiali e dei discorsi per le visite guidate, acquisendo conoscenze e storia legate al mercato azionario e ai suoi dintorni (Stock Exchange Palace)
• sostenere i responsabili degli eventi in tutti gli aspetti della gestione degli eventi (pianificazione, preparazione, esecuzione, materiale evento, gestione degli inviti e registrazione, ecc.)
• fornire supporto ad hoc al team eventi nel loro lavoro quotidiano
• supporto on-Site agli eventi Che cosa porta
• studi in Marketing, Comunicazione, Turismo, Amministrazione Bussines o Organizzazione Evento e disponibilità per i pomeriggi (da 14 a 19h Lunedì a Venerdì)
• capacità di lavorare in un ambiente dinamico e globale con eccellenti capacità organizzative e di comunicazione
• forti capacità organizzative e flessibilità personale
• disponibilità a collaborare e lavorare autonomamente abbinato a buone capacità di gestione del tempo
• ottimo livello di inglese e spagnolo parlato e scritto (minimo B2)
• esperienza nell'hosting degli eventi virtuali è un vantaggio Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Sara Perez de la Cuesta al +34 91 709 56 80 . Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette in inglese. La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

Was uns auszeichnet, treibt uns voran: zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, von Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Kommen Sie und gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen. Palace BME Events Praktikum (Nachmittagszeitplan) Madrid | Flexibles Arbeitsmodell | Referenz 8084 Sie studieren und haben Fähigkeiten im Bereich Eventmanagement, Kommunikation und Public Relations? Sie interessieren sich für den Kommunikations- und Marketingsektor und suchen ein interessantes Praktikum, um mehr über den Finanzsektor zu erfahren? Wenn Ihre Antwort ja ist, möchte unser Event- und Konferenzteam, das für Veranstaltungen und Führungen im Palacio de la Bolsa verantwortlich ist, Sie treffen. Wir suchen eine helle und engagierte Person, die gerne im Team arbeitet und ein Nachmittagspraktikum bei BME machen möchte, wo Sie im Bereich Veranstaltungen und Konferenzen praktische Hilfe leisten. Die Funktion wird im Palacio de la Bolsa de Madrid (Plaza de la Lealtad, 1). Zögern Sie nicht und bewerben Sie sich jetzt mit Ihrem Lebenslauf auf Englisch. Was Sie tun werden
• Durchführung der Führungen, Überwachung der Mailbox und Beantwortung von Anfragen für Führungen, Verwaltung und Verwaltung aller eingehenden Anfragen (Mail / Telefon)
• Zusammenarbeit bei der Entwicklung der Materialien und Reden für die Führungen, Erwerb von Wissen und Geschichte im Zusammenhang mit der Börse und ihrer Umgebung (Stock Exchange Palace)
• Unterstützung der Eventmanager in allen Aspekten des Eventmanagements (Planung, Vorbereitung, Durchführung, Eventmaterial, Einladungs- und Registrierungsmanagement etc.)
• Ad-hoc-Unterstützung des Events-Teams bei der täglichen Arbeit
• On-Site-Support bei Veranstaltungen Was du mitbringst
• Studien in Marketing, Kommunikation, Tourismus, Bussines Administration oder Veranstaltungsorganisation und Verfügbarkeit für die Nachmittage (von 14 bis 19 Uhr Montag bis Freitag)
• Fähigkeit, in einem dynamischen und globalen Umfeld mit hervorragenden Organisations- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten zu arbeiten
• starke organisatorische Fähigkeiten und persönliche Flexibilität
• Bereitschaft zur Zusammenarbeit und autonomen Arbeit gepaart mit guten Fähigkeiten im Zeitmanagement
• sehr gutes Sprach- und Schriftniveau Englisch und Spanisch (B2 Minimum)
• Erfahrung im Hosting virtueller Events ist von Vorteil Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite oder rufen Sie Sara Perez de la Cuesta unter +34 91 709 56 80 an. Für diese Stelle akzeptieren wir nur Direktbewerbungen in englischer Sprache. Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Daher suchen wir nach Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

• effectuer les visites guidées, superviser la boîte aux lettres et répondre aux demandes de visites guidées, administrer et gérer toutes les demandes reçues (courrier/téléphone)
• collaboration dans le développement des matériaux et des discours pour les visites guidées, l'acquisition de connaissances et l'histoire liées à la bourse et à ses environs (Stock Exchange Palace)
• soutenir les gestionnaires d'événements dans tous les aspects de la gestion d'événements (planification, préparation, exécution, matériel d'événements, gestion des invitations et des inscriptions, etc.)
• fournir un soutien ad hoc à l'équipe des événements dans son travail quotidien
• soutien sur site lors des manifestations Ce que vous apportez
• études en Marketing, Communication, Tourisme, Bussines Administration ou organisation d'événements et la disponibilité pour les après-midi (de 14 à 19h du lundi au vendredi)
• capacité à travailler dans un environnement dynamique et mondial avec d'excellentes compétences en matière d'organisation et de communication
• compétences organisationnelles solides et flexibilité personnelle
• la volonté de collaborer et de travailler de manière autonome, associée à de bonnes compétences en gestion du temps
• très bon niveau d'anglais et d'espagnol parlé et écrit (B2 minimum)
• l'expérience dans l'hébergement d'événements virtuels est un avantage Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Sara Perez de la Cuesta au +34 91 709 56 80 . Marketing Internship

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8092

Are you passionate about marketing, financial markets, and creating meaningful impact? Join our Exchanges Marketing team in Madrid and support the execution of marketing initiatives across primary and secondary markets.

As part of the team, you will contribute to the planning and delivery of campaigns, events, and digital activities that promote capital markets, listings, and investor engagement. • Assist in the organization of webinars, podcasts, and educational formats

• Contribute to the creation of marketing materials (presentations, visuals, basic assets)

• Assist with administrative tasks (e.g. invoicing, coordination with suppliers)

jobs.title: Accounting Specialist
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Accounting Specialist

Madrid |  Working form home up to 40% | Reference 8094

Are you passionate about finance? Do you have very good analytical skills to assess complex accounting issues under IFRS and Spanish GAAP? Do you have experience working in a multinational Group? If yes, this is the right place for you.  As an Accounting Specialist you will be part of the General Ledger team in Spain. Your tasks will consist of processing and supervising daily business activities (accounting entries, mapping of interface data, reconciliation, etc.) of the entities of the SIX Group located in Spain and France. You will contribute to monthly / quarterly / annual closing activities and reporting of said entities and work closely with different departments and locations (in particular headquarter in Switzerland) to ensure that the financial statements are prepared in accordance with IFRS, Spanish GAAP and SIX’s standards.

Does it sound interesting for you? Apply now with your CV in English!

What You Will Do

• independently process and supervise daily business and period-end closings. Prepare individual and consolidated financial statements (Cuentas Anuales), and other relevant financial and activity reports (CNMV) of the Spanish and French entities of the SIX Group.

• prepare internal reporting and support Group consolidation process. Develop and implement the accounting policies of BME and new applicable IFRS standards and/or services in line with the SIX Group accounting policies

• assess complex accounting matters under Spanish GAAP, IFRS, and other applicable legislation

• contribute to and/or lead strategic projects (e.g. restructuring, due diligence processes, PPAs, first consolidation of newly acquired companies or businesses, divestments, financial integration, impairment, etc.)

What You Bring

• university Degree in Business Administration and advanced education in Finance & Accounting (e.g. certified auditor)

• 4 years minimum experience in financial audit (Big 4 or consultancy sector preferably) or in a similar position related with accounting or financial reporting including month-end closing activities in an international Group operating in different locations

• in-depth expertise in Spanish GAAP, IFRS and consolidation. Knowledge about internal control systems and procedures will be highly valued

• good command of Excel and knowledge of SAP. Any experience with reporting tools (e.g. SAC, Power-BI) will be an advantage

• resilient, responsible, proactive, independent and honest personality interested in working on a customer-oriented team and open to work in a multi-cultural environment, having also strong analytical, time-management, communication and coordination skills

• proficiency in written and spoken English and Spanish

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Hai competenze analitiche molto buone per valutare problemi di contabilità complessi sotto IFRS e GAAP spagnolo? Hai esperienza di lavoro in un gruppo multinazionale? Se sì, questo è il posto giusto per te. In qualità di Specialista Contabile farai parte del team di General Ledger in Spagna. I vostri compiti consisteranno nel trattamento e nella supervisione delle attività aziendali quotidiane (ingressi contabili, mappatura dei dati di interfaccia, riconciliazione, ecc.) delle entità del Gruppo SIX situate in Spagna e in Francia. Contribuirai alle attività di chiusura mensili / trimestrali / annuali e alla segnalazione di tali entità e lavorerai a stretto contatto con diversi dipartimenti e sedi (in particolare sede in Svizzera) per garantire che i rendimenti finanziari siano preparati secondo gli standard IFRS, GAAP spagnolo e SIX. Ti sembra interessante? Applica ora con il tuo CV in inglese! Cosa farai
• processo indipendente e supervisionare le chiusure quotidiane di business e di fine periodo. Preparare il bilancio finanziario individuale e consolidato (Cuentas Anuales), e altri relativi rapporti finanziari e di attività (CNMV) delle entità spagnole e francesi del Gruppo SIX.
• preparare report e supporto interno processo di consolidamento del Gruppo. Sviluppare e implementare le politiche contabili di BME e i nuovi standard e/o servizi IFRS applicabili in linea con le politiche contabili del Gruppo SIX
• valutare le questioni contabili complesse in materia di GAAP spagnola, IFRS e altre leggi applicabili
• contribuire a e/o portare progetti strategici (ad esempio ristrutturazione, processi di due diligence, PPAs, primo consolidamento di società o imprese appena acquisite, divestimenti, integrazione finanziaria, disabilità, ecc.) Che cosa porta
• Laurea in Business Administration e istruzione avanzata in Finanza e Contabilità (ad esempio auditor certificati)
• Esperienza minima di 4 anni nell'audit finanziario (Grande 4 o settore di consulenza preferibilmente) o in una posizione simile in relazione alla contabilità o alla rendicontazione finanziaria, comprese le attività di chiusura di fine mese in un Gruppo internazionale che opera in diverse sedi
• competenze approfondite in spagnolo GAAP, IFRS e consolidamento. La conoscenza dei sistemi e delle procedure di controllo interno sarà altamente apprezzata
• buon comando di Excel e la conoscenza di SAP. Qualsiasi esperienza con strumenti di reporting (ad esempio SAC, Power-BI) sarà un vantaggio
• personalità resiliente, responsabile, proattiva, indipendente e onesta interessata a lavorare su un team orientato al cliente e aperto a lavorare in un ambiente multiculturale, avendo anche forti capacità analitiche, di gestione del tempo, di comunicazione e di coordinamento
• competenza in inglese e spagnolo scritto e parlato Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Sara Perez de la Cuesta al +34 91 709 56 80 . • 4 Jahre Mindesterfahrung in der Finanzprüfung (Big 4 oder vorzugsweise in der Beratungsbranche) oder in einer ähnlichen Position im Zusammenhang mit Buchhaltung oder Finanzberichterstattung, einschließlich Abschlussaktivitäten zum Monatsende in einer internationalen Gruppe, die an verschiedenen Standorten tätig ist
• fundierte Expertise in spanischen GAAP, IFRS und Konsolidierung. Wissen über interne Kontrollsysteme und -verfahren wird sehr geschätzt
• gute Kenntnisse von Excel und SAP. Jede Erfahrung mit Reporting-Tools (z. B. SAC, Power-BI) ist von Vorteil
• Belastbare, verantwortungsbewusste, proaktive, unabhängige und ehrliche Persönlichkeit, die daran interessiert ist, in einem kundenorientierten Team zu arbeiten und offen für die Arbeit in einem multikulturellen Umfeld zu sein, auch mit starken analytischen, Zeitmanagement-, Kommunikations- und Koordinationsfähigkeiten
• Kenntnisse in schriftlichem und gesprochenem Englisch und Spanisch Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite oder rufen Sie Sara Perez de la Cuesta unter +34 91 709 56 80 an. descriptionByLocale.fr:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - conduit la transformation des marchés financiers et appartient à SIX, le troisième groupe de change en Europe. Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous. Spécialiste en comptabilité Madrid: formulaire de travail à domicile jusqu'à 40%. Référence 8094 Êtes-vous passionné par la finance ? Avez-vous de très bonnes compétences analytiques pour évaluer des questions comptables complexes dans le cadre des IFRS et des GAAP espagnols? Avez-vous de l'expérience dans un groupe multinational? Si oui, c'est le bon endroit pour vous. En tant que spécialiste de la comptabilité, vous ferez partie de l'équipe General Ledger en Espagne. Vos tâches consisteront à traiter et superviser les activités quotidiennes des entreprises (entrées comptables, cartographie des données d'interface, rapprochement, etc.) des entités du groupe SIX situées en Espagne et en France. Vous contribuerez aux activités de clôture mensuelles/trimestriels/annuelles et aux rapports desdites entités et travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec différents départements et lieux (en particulier le siège social en Suisse) pour s'assurer que les états financiers sont préparés conformément aux normes IFRS, GAAP espagnoles et SIX. Ça vous paraît intéressant ? Postulez maintenant avec votre CV en anglais! Ce que vous ferez
• traiter et superviser de façon indépendante les opérations quotidiennes et les clôtures de fin d'exercice. Préparer des états financiers individuels et consolidés (Cuentas Anuales) et d'autres rapports financiers et d'activités pertinents (CNMV) des entités espagnoles et françaises du Groupe SIX.
• préparer les rapports internes et soutenir le processus de consolidation du Groupe. Élaborer et mettre en œuvre les conventions comptables du BME et les nouvelles normes et/ou services IFRS applicables conformément aux conventions comptables du Groupe SIX
• évaluer les questions comptables complexes au titre des PCGR espagnols, des IFRS et d'autres lois applicables
• contribuer ou diriger des projets stratégiques (p. ex. restructuration, processus de diligence raisonnable, AAE, première consolidation d'entreprises nouvellement acquises, cessions, intégration financière, dépréciation, etc.) Ce que vous apportez
• Diplôme universitaire en administration des affaires et enseignement supérieur en finance et comptabilité (p. ex. vérificateur certifié)
• 4 années minimum d'expérience en audit financier (Big 4 ou secteur de conseil de préférence) ou dans une situation similaire liée à l'information comptable ou financière, y compris les activités de clôture en fin de mois dans un groupe international opérant dans différents endroits
• une expertise approfondie dans les GAAP espagnols, les IFRS et la consolidation. Les connaissances sur les systèmes et les procédures de contrôle interne seront très appréciées
• bonne maîtrise d'Excel et connaissance de SAP. Toute expérience des outils de déclaration (p. ex. SAC, Power-BI) sera un avantage
• Personnalité résiliente, responsable, proactive, indépendante et honnête, désireuse de travailler dans une équipe axée sur le client et ouverte au travail dans un environnement multiculturel, ayant également de solides compétences en analyse, gestion du temps, communication et coordination
• maîtrise de l'anglais et de l'espagnol écrits et parlés Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Sara Perez de la Cuesta au +34 91 709 56 80 . Pour cette vacance, nous acceptons uniquement les candidatures directes en anglais. La diversité est importante pour nous. jobs.title: Accounting Internship
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Accounting Internship

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8093

Would you like to grow in a dynamic environment and learn how an accounting department operates? Then our team wants to hear from you!
We are an agile and collaborative team responsible for the statutory and regulatory reporting of the BME Group and its subsidiaries. Our goal is to optimize financial resources and ensure efficient reporting and accuracy of financial data. In this role, you will collaborate closely with the General Ledger and Reporting area of the finance department, participating in the different tasks from daily bookings to consolidation.

What You Will Do

• Assist in the preparation and issuance of financial reports and data analysis

• Support the implementation of financial processes and controls

• Assist in performing accounting entries

• Help with reporting to the regulator

What You Bring

• Final-year student in Business, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field

• Interest in learning and developing in the financial sector

• Strong analytical skills and attention to detail

• Good communication and teamwork skills

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and similar tools

• Fluent English (both verbal and written); other languages are a plus

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Technical Account Manager

Frankfurt |  bis zu 40% Home Office | Reference 7979

Are you passionate about bridging the gap between technology and customer success? Do you thrive in a dynamic environment where your technical and data expertise and client-facing skills make a real impact? Then we want to hear from you! We are a collaborative sales-driven team responsible for delivering tailored data services to key clients in Germany, Austria and Eastern Europe. In this role, you will work closely with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders.

What You Will Do

• Act as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for strategic and major clients for all technical coordination and 2nd level support, issue resolution, and rollout of development requests

• Support clients in enhancing existing services

• Trusted consultant and advisor for customers and be the go-to-person for all financial data content questions

• Coordinate and track usage metrics, development requests, and ensure timely communication between internal teams and clients

• Coordinate sub-contractors/partners

• Support upgrades and migrations

What You Bring

• Technical background with solid understanding of IT systems, data structures, interfaces and/or integration processes, ideally within banking or investment platforms

• Min. 3 years’ experience in technical account management or technical project management, preferably in the financial services industry

• Excellent customer orientation and communication skills with the ability to translate technical topics into business language and comprehensive understanding of the German financial market

• Strong organizational / project management skills with experience working in agile development environments is a plus

• Collaborative team player with a commercial mindset and an ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast-paced environment

• Fluent in German (C2) and English (C1)

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec  at +41583998611 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

What We Offer

Flexible Work Models

We trust our employees and offer a work environment that is well-balanced, productive and fosters success.

Personal Development

You will benefit from a culture of continuous learning and feedback. Your personal growth is supported through an extensive learning offering.

jobs.title: IT Workplace Support Specialist

titleByLocale.it: Specialista di Sostegno del Posto di Lavoro IT
titleByLocale.fr: Spécialiste de support de poste de travail IT

jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

IT Workplace Support Specialist

Zurich |  100% | Reference 7977

About the role

For our Workplace IT team, we are looking for a hands-on Level 2 Onsite Supporter who ensures stable, reliable, and user centric IT services at our Zurich site.

You act as a key contact point for our employees on site, handle complex support cases, and contribute to the continuous improvement and standardization of our workplace environment in close collaboration with central IT teams and external partners.

What You Will Do

• provide onsite 2nd level support (and backup for 1st level when required) for Windows 11 clients and standard workplace services

• handle incidents and service requests via ITSM, including IMACD activities and escalation coordination

• install, replace, and troubleshoot end user devices (laptops, monitors, docking stations, peripherals)

• support Microsoft 365, Active Directory / Azure AD user and access management

• operate and support printers, meeting rooms, and collaboration technology (Teams Rooms, video conferencing)

• support Endpoint Management (Intune / Microsoft Endpoint Manager) for device enrollment, compliance checks, and software assignments

• contribute to workplace standardization and lifecycle management (devices, accessories, meeting rooms)

• support rollouts, pilots, and refresh cycles in cooperation with central engineering teams

• ensure accurate documentation of solutions, processes, and how tos

• work closely with 3rd level engineering, service providers, and internal stakeholders

• support smaller workplace IT projects and continuous improvement initiatives

• act as a reliable onsite counterpart for central initiatives and standards

What You Bring

• 2–4+ years of experience in onsite IT support or IT service desk (Level 1/2) in enterprise environments

• strong hands-on skills in Windows 11, Microsoft 365 (Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint)

• practical experience with hardware support and structured rollouts
