jobs.title: Cloud Data Engineer
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Cloud Data Engineer

Madrid, Warsaw |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7590

SIX is recruiting a data platform engineer to work on the company wide data platform. In this role, you will be part of a cross-functional team responsible for both designing and implementing a reliable platform for analytics and data science, as well as consulting internal customers who use the platform across the organization.

What You Will Do

• Be part of an international team that designs and maintains a mature cloud native data science platform, currently serving more than 14 internal analytics teams and 600+ users.

• Closely collaborate with key stakeholders from business data science teams and IT data engineering teams to enable them on the platform. Identify new requirements, analyze platform suitability, propose best practices and existing solutions through demos...

• Act as a hands-on data engineer to onboard new use cases and optimize existing ones, build production ready ETL pipelines, ML/AI use cases and reporting solutions.

• Implement new infrastructure components with Infrastructure as code (IaC), as well as creating templates to ensure best practices and standardization among analytics teams.

What You Bring

• 4+ years of practical experience building production data pipelines, data modeling and BI tools in the cloud.

• Experience with Lakehouse architecture, preferably Databricks, with a strong knowledge of Spark and Open Table formats (Delta and/or Iceberg).

• Proficiency with Python (PySpark) and SQL with a solid understanding of software development and automation concepts like CI/CD to build production data and ML pipelines (DataOps/MLOps).

• Basic knowledge of cloud foundation services (IAM, networking, storage...), cloud costs management (FinOps) as well as tools to manage cloud infrastructure with IaC (Terraform/OpenTofu, Pulumi, bash scripting...) on Microsoft Azure (our primary cloud service provider) and/or Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform.

• Growth mindset and a very proactive attitude for continuous learning and development.

• Good presentation and communication skills. Fluency in written and spoken English.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

At BME / SIX, we build and operate modern, cloud‑ready software platforms that support critical financial market services. Our goal is to continuously evolve our technology landscape using the latest tools and engineering practices.

jobs.title: Java Backed Developer (Kubernetes)
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Java Backed Developer (Kubernetes)

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7931

SIX is looking for an experienced Software Engineer to help shape and evolve our API Management Platform and developer experience. You will drive roadmap topics, bring your own ideas, and own solutions end-to-end—from design to production operations.

You’ll have the space to propose, prototype, and productize platform capabilities that measurably improve adoption and time-to-integrate for consuming teams.

Working across multiple lines of business, you will turn business use cases into simple, secure platform capabilities and drive adoption through standards, automation, and documentation. You will partner with Architects, Engineers, Service Managers, and Security—making pragmatic trade-offs, clarifying ambiguity, and raising the bar for reliability (SLOs, observability, post-incident improvements).

You thrive in an Agile, DevOps-oriented team and enjoy taking responsibility for outcomes—not just delivering tickets.

What You Will Do

• Drive roadmap topics, propose improvements, and own whole epics end-to-end; set patterns and guardrails for the API platform

• Design and build backend services and automation APIs (REST) for self-service platform workflows on OpenShift, balancing simplicity, security, and scalability

• Improve CI/CD, automated tests, and quality gates to shorten lead time and increase confidence in production changes

• Drive API standards and platform guardrails (e.g., OpenAPI, security patterns) with Architecture and Security; enable teams with clear docs and examples

• Own reliability for your components: observability (metrics, logs, tracing), SLOs, runbooks, and post-incident improvements; contribute to security assessments/audits

• Take part in the on-call rotation (L1/L2) and reduce operational load through automation and continuous improvement

What You Bring

• Strong hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot, building and operating API-based services (REST, microservices) in production

• Engineering judgment and craftsmanship (Clean Code/Clean Architecture), with an ownership mindset and focus on maintainability

• Experience with Docker and Kubernetes/OpenShift, plus infrastructure as code and production operations

• Hands-on CI/CD and build automation (e.g., Maven), including pipelines, test strategies, and deployment automation

• Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MongoDB) and performance-aware data access

• Practical experience owning API lifecycle topics (OpenAPI, versioning, backward compatibility, and consumer-facing documentation)

• Good understanding of API security (OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, mTLS, least privilege) and experience with reviews and audits

• Strong lifecycle management in Agile teams; comfortable leading technical discussions and aligning stakeholders

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Barcelona, Bilbao, Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7926

At SIX / BME, our goal is to build and operate a cloud‑ready data and software infrastructure using modern technologies. We are looking for a Cloudera Data Engineer to work closely with platform architects, software engineers, and DevOps teams, contributing to the design and operation of high‑performance data solutions within the Cloudera ecosystem.

• Experience in Cloudera ecosystem. Cloudera manager, Ranger, Knox, Atlas, hive…

• Experience with: Spark with streaming applications (writing in Scala/Java) using Kafka Streams. Kudu and HDFS data design, Impala queries.

• experience with: XML, JSON, Avro, GIT

jobs.title: Senior Security Platforms Engineer
jobs.description:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Security Platforms Engineer

Warsaw |  Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 7629

Do you enjoy building and operating resilient, automated platforms that sit at the heart of security operations? Are you comfortable owning production systems, improving them through code, and thinking in terms of reliability, failure modes, and scale?

We are looking for a Senior Security Platforms Engineer to strengthen our Cyber Security Engineering team. The role focuses on engineering, automation, and reliability of critical security data platforms, while supporting a broad set of domains such as security logging, detection pipelines, and platform integrations. The role focuses on engineering and automation over manual operations.

Our platforms process and transport security and operational relevant data at scale across multiple regions. This role combines hands‑on platform ownership with SRE principles , strong automation, and close collaboration with security engineering and operations teams.

The role is intended as senior , but we are open to strong mid‑level candidates who demonstrate the right mindset, technical depth, and growth potential.

What You Will Do

• Own and improve security‑critical platforms that ingest, process, and store large‑scale data (e.g. Elastic‑based platforms, messaging pipelines), ensuring reliability, scalability, and integrity of security‑relevant data.

• Drive reliability improvements using SRE principles , reducing operational toil and systematically addressing failure modes, data loss scenarios, and resilience under stress.

• Design and implement automation and infrastructure‑as‑code using Terraform and GitLab CI/CD, enabling reproducible, auditable, and scalable environments.

• Develop and maintain  Python‑based tooling to automate workflows, integrate systems, and eliminate manual operational effort.

• Design, deploy, and operate workloads on container‑based platforms (Kubernetes / OpenShift) as a platform user, while supporting data pipelines (Elastic, logstash, Kafka) and collaborating with platform and security teams globally.

What You Bring

• Core expectations (senior level):

• Strong experience in  platform engineering / SRE / infrastructure roles , with end‑to‑end ownership of production systems .

• Proven expertise in  Terraform, Git‑based CI/CD, and Python , designing and implementing automation in production environments .

• Practical experience working with  Kubernetes platforms as a user , deploying and operating workloads reliably at scale.

• Experience with  data‑intensive or security‑relevant platforms (Elastic Stack, Kafka, log pipelines, Splunk, Opensearch), including performance, scaling, and operational trade‑offs.

• Strong production mindset: experience with  on‑call, incident response, and understanding of system failure modes , combined with a proactive, ownership‑driven approach.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec  at +41583998611 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Project Management Officer

titleByLocale.fr: Spécialiste de la gestion des projets

jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Project Management Officer

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7958

We are looking for an experienced Project Management Officer (PMO) to strengthen the delivery and governance of projects within SIX Securities Services, a leading provider of post trade services in the financial industry.
This role sits within the Business Support department and acts as an internal consulting function, supporting project teams and senior stakeholders to ensure high quality, on time and on budget project delivery across a complex and regulated environment.
As part of the team you will work in an international financial services environment, contributing to the continuous development of project management capabilities while supporting strategic initiatives with real business impact.

Don't hesitate and apply now with your CV in English. We are looking forward to hear from you.

What You Will Do

• Plan, monitor and control project deliverables, milestones and KPIs, mantaining and structured project communication and stakeholder management

• Support and coordinate project team meetings, project boards, workshops and steering committees

• Perform project controlling activities, including financial reporting and actively manage RAID topics (Risks, Assumptions, Issues and Decisions)

• Define, maintain and continuously improve project management methods, standards, documentation and templates

• Collaborate in the harmonisation, optimisation and innovation of project management processes and support the onboarding of new employees into the division’s project environment

• Capture lessons learned and proactively propose improvements

What You Bring

• University degree in IT, finance, business management or any related field. PMP or PRINCE 2 certifications will be valuable.

• At least 5 years of experience in a Project Management Office or similar role

• Solid project management skills, including agile methodologies (e.g. Scrum) . Jira/Confluence

• Good understanding of financial services, banking and/or insurance processes is an advantage

• Strong analytical, organizational and communication skills with a proactive, structured and result oriented mindset with also a strong customer focus

• Fluent written and spoken English and Spanish

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Business Analyst

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7801

At BME Exchange, we are looking for an experienced, customer-orientated business analyst to work on the business rollout of projects and enhancements to the SIX Swiss Exchange and BME Exchange. Are you a flexible team player, passionate about implementing initiatives in an Agile framework environment? Are you motivated to learn about the regulatory framework governing financial market infrastructure and securities trading and analyse how these are affected by new initiatives?

This is your chance to experience the stock exchange from the inside, in a unique, fast paced, and inspiring environment. In this role you will participate in the creation of the common Spanish and Swiss trading platform, contributing to its functional development and market innovation.

Don't hesitate and apply now with your CV in English!

What You Will Do

• Coordinate and ensure changes are rolled out to clients seamlessly

• Write business documents, including interface specifications, and communications to support clients integrating changes into their internal systems

• Coordinate and perform acceptance tests for the Spanish Market and Exchanges platform (SMART), SIX Swiss Exchange and the future common Spanish and Swiss trading platform Equinox

• Analyze and assess business initiatives in Equity, Fixed Interest and Derivatives Trading

• Research for the impact of these changes on SSX and BME Regulatory documents and work with internal teams to ensure Regulators are informed of and approve changes in a timely manner

What You Bring

• Minimum 5 years’ experience as a Business Analyst in financial services

• Ambition to work independently and take responsibility in a small team

• Good communication skills as well as systematic and accurate working methods

• Strong analytical and conceptual reasoning and the ability to impart knowledge

• Very good verbal and written skills in Spanish and English. German is a plus.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Solution Analyst - Asset Service IT

titleByLocale.fr: Analyste en solutions - Service des actifs IT

jobs.description:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Solution Analyst - Asset Service IT

Olten |  100% | Reference 7804

Are you passionate about working in IT within the financial industry and enjoy collaborating closely with both business and IT stakeholders? In this role, you will design and shape solutions in close partnership with the business and technology teams, using your strong communication and organizational skills. Join our Asset Services IT team and help deliver impactful solutions within the Corporate Actions domain.

What You Will Do

• Proactively liaise with business and product management teams to identify improvements and opportunities

• For new projects and changes prepare scalable, secure, cost-effective solutions based on the business requirements

• Stakeholder management and communicate milestones to the stakeholders

• Prepare solution documents for IT to start development, guide the IT development

• Prepare test case that development team can use to test the new development

• Testing and analyzing the developed code to ensure it meets business requirements and follows all development guidelines and standards

What You Bring

• Relevant professional experience (10+ years) in IT Development along with Solution design.

• Working knowledge in COBOL and Java (Spring Boot framework) & Asset servicing/Corporate Actions business knowledge/experience is required

• Understanding of SWIFT Messaging MT/MX Standard

• Should have the capability to learn new tools and IT concept, as well as set priorities, good trouble shooting skills and high motivation

• Very good knowledge in Microsoft Office, Confluence, Share Point etc. Should be also comfortable with Jira

• Very good communication skills in English, German would be a plus

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Maria Teresa Buchanan  at +41 58 399 8083 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Solution Analyst - Asset Service IT Olten | 100% | Reference 7804 Sei appassionato di lavorare nell'IT nel settore finanziario e ti piace collaborare strettamente con sia le aziende che gli stakeholder IT? In questo ruolo, progetta e modella soluzioni in stretta collaborazione con i team aziendali e tecnologici, utilizzando le tue forti competenze comunicative e organizzative. Unisciti al nostro team di servizi informatici Asset e aiuta a fornire soluzioni di impatto all'interno del dominio Corporate Actions. Cosa farete
• Incollaggi proattivi con i team di business e product management per individuare miglioramenti e opportunità
• Per nuovi progetti e cambiamenti preparare soluzioni scalabili, sicure, economicamente efficaci in base alle esigenze aziendali
• Gestione delle parti interessate e comunicare le tappe principali agli stakeholder
• Preparare documenti di soluzione per l'IT per avviare lo sviluppo, guidare lo sviluppo IT

• Testare e analizzare il codice sviluppato per garantire che soddisfi i requisiti aziendali e segue tutte le linee guida di sviluppo e standards What You Bring
• Esperienza professionale rilevante (10+ anni) nello sviluppo IT insieme alla progettazione di soluzioni.

• Dovrebbe avere la capacità di imparare nuovi strumenti e concetto IT, così come priorità fissate, buone capacità di tiro difficoltà e alta motivazione
• Ottime conoscenze in Microsoft Office, Confluence, Share Point ecc. Dovrebbe essere anche comodo con Jira

Per questo posto vacante accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette. La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi sfondo personale.

jobs.title: Business Information Security Officer

titleByLocale.fr: Agent de la sécurité de l'information commerciale

jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Business Information Security Officer

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7942

Information security is a key requirement for the successful and compliant operation of Securities Services. As a Business Information Security Officer (BISO), you act as the main point of contact for information security topics within Securities Services, supporting the appropriate handling of security risks, regulatory obligations, and internal security requirements in line with SIX standards.
In this role, you work closely with business, IT, and security stakeholders to ensure that information security requirements are well understood and applied in a pragmatic and business‑oriented manner. You support initiatives and day‑to‑day activities by providing guidance, facilitating alignment between parties, and contributing to a consistent security approach across the organization.
You will collaborate with central security teams, IT, legal, risk, and compliance functions, and be part of the wider BISO community within SIX.

We are looking forward to hear for you. Please apply with your CV in English.

What You Will Do

• Act as a key contact and advisor for information security topics within the assigned business area, supporting managers and key stakeholders

• Advise and support projects, applications, and initiatives in implementing information security requirements in line with SIX standards and best practices

• Contribute to the identification, assessment, and handling of information security risks affecting the business area

• Facilitate effective collaboration between business, IT, and security functions to ensure pragmatic and proportionate security solutions

• Support the interpretation and application of regulatory, contractual, and internal security requirements (e.g. data protection, industry standards)

• Contribute to security awareness, reporting, and continuous improvement activities, and actively participate in the SIX BISO community

What You Bring

• 4 years of professional experience in information security, IT risk, IT, or a related field. Relevant training or certification in information security will be a plus

• Good understanding of information security principles, risk management, and control concepts with ability to understand technical security topics and communicate them clearly to non‑technical stakeholders

• Familiarity with regulatory and compliance requirements relevant to financial services is an advantage

• Structured and solution‑oriented working style, with attention to detail

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a pragmatic and service‑oriented mindset and ability to manage multiple topics in parallel and work effectively with a range of stakeholders

• Fluency in English and Spanish (both written and spoken)  German is an advantage but not mandatory

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer - Containerization & Cloud
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

DevOps Engineer - Containerization & Cloud

Barcelona, Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7624

Do you want to work in an agile environment where passion, trust, innovation, and operational excellence drive everything we do? Are you eager to learn, bring new ideas, and tackle challenges in a modern DevOps setup? We are looking for an Application DevOps Engineer focused on automated cloud deployments and container platforms. In this role, you will support development teams by designing and operating Kubernetes/OpenShift platforms, automating infrastructure and deployment processes, providing standardized CI/CD pipelines, and configuring shared operational services. Working with tools like Kubernetes, OpenShift, Argo CD, GitLab, Ansible, and container registries, you will help build scalable release processes, improve deployment reliability, and ensure consistent ado

ption of DevOps and GitOps best practices.

What You Will Do

• Build and maintain automated deployment workflows for containerized applications in Kubernetes/OpenShift.

• Manage GitOps processes using Argo CD and GitLab CI/CD, including rollout strategies and configuration management.

• Implement Infrastructure‑as‑Code (Helm, Terraform/Ansible) for consistent and auditable changes.

• Work with application and infrastructure teams to onboard and standardize services on Kubernetes/OpenShift.

• Improve monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and runbooks for reliable operations.

• Contribute to cluster upgrades, performance tuning, and capacity planning.

• Develop and support CI/CD pipelines, reusable automation templates, and onboarding materials.

• Assist teams with pipeline integration, secrets management, and observability.

• Document standards and promote DevOps best practices.

What You Will Bring

• Experience in DevOps, SRE, or Platform Engineering, especially with Kubernetes/OpenShift.

• Strong skills in Python, shell scripting, GitLab CI/CD, and Argo CD.

• Knowledge of Infrastructure‑as‑Code, preferably with Ansible and Helm.

• Solid understanding of Linux, networking, and containerization concepts.

• Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, Splunk).

• Strong troubleshooting skills in microservices environments.

• Clear communication skills with both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.

• Fluency in English; German or Spanish is a plus.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Business Development & Strategy Specialist
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Business Development & Strategy Specialist

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7587

SIX Securities Services are powers the core post-trade infrastructure for Swiss, Spanish and international markets. From clearing and settlement to custody and collateral management, we ensure securities transactions are processed safely, efficiently, and reliably across markets. BSS runs interoperable CCP and CSD platforms, connects participants worldwide, and delivers value-added services that support banks, brokers, and institutional investors throughout the full post-trade lifecycle.

Our Business Development & Strategy team sits within the BSS COO organization, which spans all products and drives strategy execution, transformation, and performance. We complement the product and business development experts in each product vertical and are responsible for executing strategy across BSS and unlocking new growth. We lead transversal initiatives, cultivate strategic partnerships, and identify cross-Business Unit synergies. Our remit includes shaping and executing M&A, steering priority strategic programs, and turning data into action through business intelligence and analytics. We also enable our commercial teams with strategic sales support to maximize market impact.

As a Business Development & Strategy Specialist, you’ll help shape the future of SIX Securities Services by driving initiatives that span the entire post-trade value chain. You’ll operate at the intersection of strategy, business development and market intelligence—translating ideas into tangible growth and supporting execution across all product areas (Clearing, Custody, Securities Finance, and Trade Repositories). This high-visibility role offers close collaboration with senior leadership, product teams and external partners—giving you a front-row seat to influence direction and deliver measurable results.

What You Will Do

• Shape and drive strategic growth initiatives across the Securities Services value chain – connecting the product verticals Clearing, Custody, Securities Finance and Trade Repositories into integrated, client-centric solutions.

• Translate strategic priorities into actionable initiatives by developing business cases, coordinating stakeholders across product verticals and Business Units (Exchanges, Financial Information and Banking Services) and supporting execution.

• Conduct market and competitor analysis to identify trends, client needs and partnership opportunities that impact and enhance SIX’s positioning as leading European Financial Market Infrastructure

• Support strategic projects and M&A activities, including opportunity assessment, due diligence and integration preparation.

• Develop management insights and communication materials – dashboards, presentations, and reports – to enable informed decisions and track progress on strategic initiatives.

What You Bring

• Educational background in finance, economics or business administration with strong understanding of financial service industry and trends

• A minimum of 3 years of experience in capital markets, financial market infrastructure or securities services, ideally in clearing, settlement, custody, securities finance incl. collateral management or trade repositories. Relevant work experience in consulting, corporate strategy or investment banking is a plus

• Strong analytical, conceptual and strategic thinking skills with proven ability to translate complex market and business insights into actionable plans, combined with excellent problem-solving, communication and presentation skills, capable of engaging both internal management and external partners

• Structured and proactive working style, comfortable coordinating multiple stakeholders across business lines, locations, and hierarchies

• Fluent in English (both verbal & writing); German and/or Spanish as a plus

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

We lead transversal initiatives, cultivate strategic partnerships, and identify cross-Business Unit synergies. Our remit includes shaping and executing M&A, steering priority strategic programs, and turning data into action through business intelligence and analytics. We also enable our commercial teams with strategic sales support to maximize market impact. As a Business Development & Strategy Specialist, you’ll help shape the future of SIX Securities Services by driving initiatives that span the entire post-trade value chain. You’ll operate at the intersection of strategy, business development and market intelligence—translating ideas into tangible growth and supporting execution across all product areas (Clearing, Custody, Securities Finance, and Trade Repositories). This high-visibility role offers close collaboration with senior leadership, product teams and external partners—giving you a front-row seat to influence direction and deliver measurable results. What You Will Do
• Shape and drive strategic growth initiatives across the Securities Services value chain – connecting the product verticals Clearing, Custody, Securities Finance and Trade Repositories into integrated, client-centric solutions.
• Translate strategic priorities into actionable initiatives by developing business cases, coordinating stakeholders across product verticals and Business Units (Exchanges, Financial Information and Banking Services) and supporting execution.
• Conduct market and competitor analysis to identify trends, client needs and partnership opportunities that impact and enhance SIX’s positioning as leading European Financial Market Infrastructure
• Support strategic projects and M&A activities, including opportunity assessment, due diligence and integration preparation.
• Develop management insights and communication materials – dashboards, presentations, and reports – to enable informed decisions and track progress on strategic initiatives. What You Bring
• Educational background in finance, economics or business administration with strong understanding of financial service industry and trends
• A minimum of 3 years of experience in capital markets, financial market infrastructure or securities services, ideally in clearing, settlement, custody, securities finance incl. collateral management or trade repositories. Relevant work experience in consulting, corporate strategy or investment banking is a plus
• Strong analytical, conceptual and strategic thinking skills with proven ability to translate complex market and business insights into actionable plans, combined with excellent problem-solving, communication and presentation skills, capable of engaging both internal management and external partners
• Structured and proactive working style, comfortable coordinating multiple stakeholders across business lines, locations, and hierarchies
• Fluent in English (both verbal & writing); German and/or Spanish as a plus If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 . jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

AI Engineer

Madrid, Warsaw |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7655

Join us in shaping the future of financial information. This is a high-leverage, player-coach role at the heart of how we scale AI delivery. You will set the technical direction for production-grade AI solutions. If you are passionate about agentic AI, enjoy solving hard engineering problems, and want to see your work used daily by real users in a critical products, this is a unique opportunity to have a tangible impact from day one.

What You Will Do

• Architect Multi-Agent Systems: Design, build, and orchestrate complex agentic workflows using LangGraph and LangChain to handle sophisticated financial queries and agents.

• Productize AI & GenAI Solutions: Build the backends, agent/RAG infrastructure, MCP servers, and LLM-serving layers that turn models, prompts, and pipelines into reliable, observable production products.

• Champion Quality & Coach Peers: Apply clean architecture and proven design patterns, enforce standards through tests and reviews, and coach junior engineers and rotating contributors.

• Implement Advanced RAG: Build and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems to ground model responses in proprietary data.

• Establish Evaluation Pipelines: Create rigorous testing frameworks and metrics to evaluate agent performance, reliability, and accuracy in a production environment.

What You Bring

• Core AI Engineering Stack: Deep expertise in Python and the modern AI stack, including LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI SDK, and Hugging Face Transformers. Strong ability to debug and optimize multi-agent workflows, with a focus on asynchronous execution, state management, and concurrency.

• API & Data Proficiency: Experience designing and integrating with complex REST/GraphQL endpoints and handling structured data formats (JSON/XML) for tool calling.

• Cloud & DevOps Mindset: Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker) and cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure) for deploying production-grade AI applications.

• Quality & Collaboration: Strong testing discipline with pytest, a habit of writing maintainable, well-typed code, and the communication skills to mentor peers and partner closely with data scientists and AI engineers.

• Experience & Education: 5+ years in software Engineering including significant experience in as a Gen AI Application Developer. A relevant degree in Computer Science or related field is required.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Senior AI Backend Engineer Madrid, Warsaw | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7655 Join SIX Financial Information's AI Engineering team as a Senior AI Backend Engineer of our Productization squad. You will own the backend, APIs, and integrations that turn AI prototypes into production-grade products in our GenAI and Data Mining lines. This is a high-leverage, player-coach role at the heart of how we scale AI delivery. You will set the technical direction for production-grade engineering, partner with data scientists and AI engineers on serving and integration patterns, and free the AI Solutions team to focus on models and evals while your squad owns reliable delivery to end users What You Will Do
• Productize AI & GenAI Solutions: Build the backends, agent/RAG infrastructure, MCP servers, and LLM-serving layers that turn models, prompts, and pipelines into reliable, observable production products.
• Design & Build Production APIs: Architect and maintain endpoints and GraphQL APIs, defining schema, resolver, and authentication patterns that serve frontend applications, internal services, and AI features.
• Integrate Data & AI Pipelines: Develop ingestion, parsing, OCR, and vendor-LLM integrations (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic) with strong attention to concurrency, async processing, retries, idempotency, and state-machine workflows.
• Operate in Production: Partner with MLOps on Docker, Terraform, and Azure DevOps CI/CD; establish performance baselines and observability for both APIs and AI workloads; optimize for latency, throughput, and cost.
• Champion Quality & Coach Peers: Apply clean architecture and proven design patterns, enforce standards through tests and reviews, and coach junior engineers and rotating contributors. What You Bring
• Backend Expertise: Deep proficiency in Python and hands-on experience designing and scaling modern APIs (e.g. FastAPI) in production, including async/await for I/O-bound workloads. Production experience with GraphQL (Strawberry or comparable) is a strong plus.
• AI Productization Experience: Hands-on experience integrating LLMs and AI APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic) into production systems, with familiarity in RAG, agent frameworks, vector databases, MCP, or ML serving patterns.
• Data & Persistence: Strong production experience with PostgreSQL, SQLModel/SQLAlchemy, and Alembic, including schema design, indexing, and efficient queries.
• Cloud & DevOps: Solid working experience with Google Cloud Platform and/or Azure, Terraform, Docker, Git workflows, and CI/CD pipelines (Gitlab or equivalent).
• Quality & Collaboration: Strong testing discipline with pytest, a habit of writing maintainable, well-typed code, and the communication skills to mentor peers and partner closely with data scientists and AI engineers.
• Experience & Education: 5+ years in Backend Development, Software Engineering, or Systems Architecture, including significant experience designing and operating production systems. A relevant degree in Computer Science or related field is required. English fluency is required. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko at +34 917095993 . jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Customer Operations Specialist with German

Warsaw |  up tp 40% working from home possible | Reference 7770



As a key contributor to our sales operations, you will manage a defined customer territory in close collaboration with a Sales Representative. You will also take ownership of all administrative and support activities related to sales and the implementation of financial information systems for our clients.

What You Will Do

• Territory Management: Oversee a customer sales territory in partnership with Sales and Account Managers, focusing on financial services products in Swiss German and German customers

• Client Service: Serve as a primary point of contact for customer inquiries related to products, functionalities, data, pricing, exchange permissions, and issue resolution

• Contract Administration: Draft, process, and manage customer contracts within the financial customer information system

• Billing & Financial Oversight: Initiate invoicing processes and monitor dunning procedures and accruals to ensure financial accuracy

• Project Coordination: Manage product and data entitlements, and plan, coordinate, and track customer and sales-related projects from initiation to completion

What You Bring

• at least 3 years of experience in a similar role, preferably in a middle or back-office environment

• strong numerical aptitude and attention to detail

• customer-focused with a proactive and well-organized approach

• ability to work independently and collaboratively in a dynamic environment

• language Proficiency: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in  English and German

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska  at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Data Scientist

Warsaw, Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7592

Join our Data Science, Analytics, and AI team at SIX BFI, a leader in the financial data industry. We are looking for a passionate and experienced Senior Data Scientist to drive the development of innovative AI-powered solutions. You will work on a wide range of initiatives, from extracting intelligence from unstructured data to building production-grade analytical applications. If you are a proactive, hands-on leader who thrives on solving complex challenges and wants to make a significant impact, this is the role for you.

What You Will Do

• Lead AI/Analytics Projects: Owns the end-to-end lifecycle of data science projects, from ideation and stakeholder engagement to deployment and iteration, ensuring alignment with business goals.

• Develop Advanced AI/ML Models: Leverage cutting-edge AI, NLP, and machine learning techniques to extract structured insights from unstructured financial documents and alternative data sources.

• Build Production-Ready Solutions: Design, build, and deploy robust, production-grade AI solutions, including analytical chatbots and critical applications that deliver actionable insights from our vast datasets.

• Act as a Data Evangelist: Develop a deep understanding of our vast financial datasets and act as a subject matter expert, collaborating directly with business stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into data-driven solutions.

• Collaborate and Mentor: Work closely with cross-functional teams of engineers, product managers, and other data scientists. Mentor junior team members and foster a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning.

What You Bring

• Technical Expertise: Deep proficiency in Python and its data science ecosystem (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn, spaCy). Extensive experience with Databricks, PySpark, and dbt for large-scale data processing and transformation.

• API and Backend Skills: Proven experience building production-ready APIs using frameworks like FastAPI and interacting with databases using tools like SQLAlchemy.

• DevOps & MLOps Mindset: Strong understanding of software development best practices. Hands-on experience with Docker for containerization and Git for version control.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Business Analyst - Market Data & Entitlements (with French)

Warsaw |  working from home up to 40% | Reference 7630

Would you like to dive into the fascinating world of market data? As part of a team of specialists you will help build and operate reliable market data and entitlement flows for French Products (Finalim, PGD, Europerf). You will analyze and specify requirements for pricing and reference content sourced from MDF Stream/MDF Select, IPS and some direct contributors. You will ensure this content is normalized, high quality, and distributed to all French Products and clients with the correct licensing and access controls. Working closely with product, engineering, operations, and QA, you’ll translate MDF and IPS specifications and market rules into clear, testable documentation that enables accurate data delivery. You will occupy a central position between two data models (Global and FR) that allow French products to fully benefit from the rich market data of the global model.

What You Will Do

• Gather and document the functional and non-functional requirements of real-time and end-of-day price data feeds, as well as the repositories provided by MDF and IPS, to cover all the needs of French products (Finalim, PGD, Europerf). Define the standardization, enrichment, and validation rules.

• Design and maintain entitlement models and content distribution rules for French products, ensuring compliance with provider licensing and contractual constraints.

• Support onboarding and certification of new/changed feeds from MDF and IPS. Coordinate test scenarios, ensure their validation and non-regression across the entire system.

• Investigate incidents and drive corrective actions with providers and internal teams.

• Contribute to market data documentation & standards and process improvements across all delivery channels for French Products (MDF, IPS, Finalim, PGD, Europerf, and TDI for entitlement).

What You Bring

• 2–5 years of business analysis experience in market data or financial information.

• Strong understanding of market data concepts, normalization, and data quality controls.

• Experience with market data providers and feeds. Knowledge of access rights frameworks and models, data distribution flows, and licensing obligations.

• Ability to translate business rules into technical specifications and test cases; solid documentation skills.

• Proficiency with SQL and Excel; familiarity with APIs and file-based delivery; comfortable collaborating with product, engineering, QA, and operations.

• Exposure to agile methods (e.g., Jira/Azure DevOps) and quality assurance practices (UAT, regression).

• Fluent English (B2/C1) & French (B2) are mandatory. Comfortable communicating in a global, cross functional environment.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills  at +44 207 550 5407 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: HR Consultant
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

HR Consultant

Warsaw |  up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 7875

Are you ready to take on a dynamic role that combines personnel management with hands-on HR advisory and coaching for managers and employees?

We are looking for a dedicated and experienced professional with strong expertise in HR consulting who is passionate about making an impact. If this sounds like you, we invite you to apply for the position of HR Consultant.

In this role, you will report to the Head of HR Advisory in Switzerland and collaborate with international HR consultants to support managers and employees located in Switzerland.

What You Will Do

• provide guidance and support to managers and employees based in Switzerland on HR operational topics related to the full employee life cycle (recruitment, assessment, development, retention, transfer, etc.)

• ensure proper execution of HR processes to mitigate risk, while actively identifying workflow inefficiencies and driving continuous improvement

• collaborate with HRBP’s, HR Centers of Expertise and the HR Service Center to deliver cohesive and aligned HR solutions that meet business needs

• manage a variety of administrative and coordination tasks to support seamless HR operations

• coordinate and implement the annual compensation review process within the assigned area of responsibility

• work in partnership with both team members in Switzerland and global HR teams and departments, actively contributing to the implementation of Swiss and global HR projects and initiatives

What You Bring

• master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline

• at least 5 years of professional experience in HR consulting or personnel management, including a minimum of 2 years working in an international HR environment, supporting European-based staff, preferably in Switzerland

• strong track record in consulting, with demonstrated problem-solving abilities and excellent interpersonal communication skills

• proven ability to function within an international matrix structure and manage diverse cultural dynamics

• proficiency in HR Information Systems (HRIS), particularly SAP SuccessFactors

• excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in German is considered a strong advantage

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska  at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Lead Data Platform Engineer (Databricks)
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Lead Data Platform Engineer (Databricks)

Madrid, Warsaw |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7582

Join SIX Financial Information's AI Engineering team as the Lead Data Platform Engineer of our  Data Platform & Analytics  squad. You will own the roadmap and evolution of our Data Science Platform on Azure and Databricks the self-service foundation that data scientists, analysts, business analysts, and AI engineers across the organization rely on to turn complex financial data into production-ready insights.

This is a player-coach leadership role with direct line management responsibility for a small squad. You will remain close to the code, set technical direction for the platform, partner closely with the rest of the team to productionize what we build while partnering with other technical and business stakeholders.

What You Will Do

• Own the Data Science Platform Roadmap: Define and drive the technical strategy for the DSP on Azure Databricks, balancing platform stability, self-service capabilities, and the evolving needs of data scientists and AI engineers.

• Productize Analytics Solutions: Lead the productization of the advanced dashboarding and analytics data products, turning prototypes into reliable, well-governed, scalable data products that can be reliably consumed by end users.

• Build Self-Service Foundations: Design and operate the lakehouse architecture, data pipelines and curated models, and governance patterns (Unity Catalog, dbt, access controls) that enable analysts and scientists to work autonomously on financial data.

• Lead and Grow the Squad: Line manage and and mentor a small team of data platform engineers, set engineering standards, review design and code, and coordinate with rotating contributors to deliver against the roadmap.

• Partner Across Teams: Collaborate closely with the MLOps / Platform Engineering team on CI/CD and observability, with the AI Solutions and Productization squads on data needs, and with business stakeholders to align the platform with real analytics and self-service use cases.

What You Bring

• Technical Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with Azure Databricks, Spark, Delta Lake, dbt, SQL, and Python. Solid command of lakehouse architectures, data modeling, analytics engineering practices and production-grade data pipelines.

• Platform Mindset: Proven experience designing and operating data platforms in enterprise or regulated environments, including Unity Catalog governance and cost/performance optimization.

• Player-coach Leadership: Experience leading or mentoring a small technical team while staying hands-on in architecture, implementation, code reviews, and production delivery.

• Productization & Self-Service: Experience taking analytics or data products from prototype to production and enabling self-service consumption by non-platform teams (data scientists, analysts, business users).

• Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with financial data structures and the demands of data-driven systems in complex, regulated organizations is highly desirable.

• Experience & Education: 5+ years in data engineering, analytics engineering, or data platform roles. Relevant degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; Azure or Databricks certifications are a strong plus. English fluency is required.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.
